chapters.title: Chapter 81 -81-Server-Wide First Kill – Legendary-Grade BOSS
paragraphs: Before the entrance to the rift, countless Shadowkin warriors continued to pour forth without end.
Avelia hovered in midair, silently looking down over everything below.
Then, in the very next moment, Avelia suddenly whipped her head toward the distance.
An incomparably familiar figure appeared before her eyes.
A look of instant dread surfaced in her gaze, and she retreated several steps in succession.
"Wh-what... what is going on?!"
"Carodion? You... weren’t you dead?"
Avelia stared at Carodion in utter shock.

That unique divine aura belonging only to a legendary-grade powerhouse, along with the terrifying holy power surging from his body, proved beyond doubt that this was the Watcher who guarded this place—Carodion.
"What kind of joke is this? That’s impossible!!!"
Avelia’s pupils contracted sharply.
"That’s impossible!"
She could accept Daniel escaping, because in her eyes he was nothing more than a weak and insignificant insect.
But she absolutely could not accept Carodion coming back to life.
"Wait... that fragment of remains... could that have been the doing of that little insect from before?"
"How is that even possible? What exactly did he do?!"
"If all humans can be revived... then wouldn’t my Shadowkin become a complete joke?!"
At this moment, Avelia felt as though the world before her had become utterly unfamiliar.
And while Avelia was sinking into near-madness, Daniel slowly appeared behind Carodion.
As he looked at Carodion’s back, a trace of deep respect appeared in his eyes.
Then he fixed Avelia with a cold stare and said, "I ask that you slay this demon."
Before the final word had even fully left his mouth, Avelia already felt a violent gust rushing straight at her.
Carodion transformed into a streak of golden radiance and shot toward Avelia, the longsword in his hand erupting with divine light as though it could erase all impurity from existence.
"You’re courting death!"
Sharp claws instantly sprang from Avelia’s hands.
Boom—boom!
The moment the two figures collided, a burst of blazing sparks exploded outward.
Avelia managed to receive Carodion’s strike.
But not only was she not pleased, her heart was instead seized by overwhelming terror.
Because in that instant, she understood one thing perfectly clearly.
The Carodion before her could not possibly be some kind of fake.
Run!
That thought flashed through Avelia’s mind at once.
What kind of absurdity was this?!
Under normal circumstances, even when she and Azmodar, the two great Shadowkin lords, joined forces, they still could not do anything to Carodion.
Fight him one-on-one?
She did not think she had lived too long and grown tired of being alive.
Avelia no longer cared in the slightest about the rest of the Shadowkin soldiers still on the battlefield.
She turned and fled at once, trying to escape without hesitation.
Seeing her spin around and run without the slightest intention of fighting, Carodion gave a cold laugh.
A boundless brilliance burst from the sword in his hand.
A dazzling golden light flashed across the blade.
Then he surged forward and brought it down in a single slash.
"Secret Art—Sacred Judgment!"
Srrrip!
Pfft!
Avelia’s claws were severed by force.
At the same time, all the strength in her body seemed to be drained away in an instant.
Boom!
A beam of violet light crashed down from the heavens.
Avelia slammed brutally into the ground, blasting a massive crater into the earth.
A deep and wide wound extended from the center of her brow all the way to her abdomen.
Her body had nearly been split in two.
Avelia could no longer move.
She did not even possess the strength to open her mouth and speak.
She stared at Carodion, her eyes filled with unwillingness, despair, and utter disbelief.
"Wait a moment!"
Daniel suddenly called out, stopping Carodion just as he was about to deliver the finishing blow.
"Let me do it."
He turned to Carodion and said those words calmly.
Carodion nodded.
"As you wish, sir."
Daniel walked to a spot not far from Avelia.
He raised the Moon Reaper in his hand.
Three Aetherlances were charged and ready to fire.
The golden spears tore through the air and pierced through Avelia’s body in an instant.
Blood-red damage numbers rose above Avelia’s head.
[Void Arrow] dealt 1000% damage against abyssal Shadowkin creatures.
On top of that, with the guaranteed critical-hit effect of [Fate Stone], the damage of this one strike had reached a horrifying level of over thirty million.
At this point, the legendary-grade Shadowkin powerhouse Avelia had fallen completely.
[Ding! You have slain the Shadowkin leader Boss · Nightmare Queen Avelia (legendary-grade)!]
[Obtained EXP +15 billion! Obtained Contribution Points +1,000,000!]
At the same time, a server-wide announcement rang out.
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of Universe No. 616 has slain the legendary-grade Shadowkin powerhouse "Nightmare Queen · Avelia," becoming the first player to kill a legendary-grade Boss!]
[Special rewards granted to this player: Contribution Points +100,000, gold coin +100,000!]
[Special reward granted to this player: "Fate Stone (supreme-grade)"!]
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of Universe No. 616 has successfully repelled the Shadowkin invasion! Special reward granted to this player: the unique special talent "Eternal Ring"!]
The two consecutive world announcements left players everywhere somewhat stunned.
"Wait, what? A legendary-grade powerhouse... that’s it?"
"No, seriously, I already got my popcorn ready to watch the show, and now you’re telling me the enemy’s already on its knees??"
"Can somebody tell me where to report bugs in this game? There is absolutely no way this Faustus is normal. He’s definitely abusing some kind of game exploit!"
"What even is this so-called Shadowkin? I thought they were supposed to be terrifying, but in the end they were just padding for the numbers!"
"Exactly. The name sounded scary, but they’re probably just a few trash mobs. Can’t be that much stronger than goblins!"
Meanwhile, the players of World 616 were so excited they could barely contain themselves.
"Invincible! Faustus handled the Shadowkin invasion all by himself. Tell me, who else can do that?!"
"No, hold on, I want to ask the same thing. Has Faustus already leveled to the point where he can kill a legendary-grade Boss now???"
"Holy shit! That was a legendary-grade enemy! I haven’t even seen a legendary-grade Boss before!"
"Faustus is forever the one true god!"
Daniel looked at the system notification and was briefly taken aback.
What kind of item was [Fate Stone]?
In all his previous lives, he did not seem to remember ever hearing of it.
He reached into his inventory and took out the gemstone shimmering with seven-colored light.
[Fate Stone (supreme-grade)]
Effect:
1. All skills and attacks (including normal attacks) will use the damage value of your strongest damage-dealing skill as their base value.
2. After equipping this special item, all attacks are guaranteed to crit and will additionally inflict the effect [Fate Interference]!
[Fate Interference] (non-stackable): reduces all target attributes by 60%!
Description: A fragment once lost to the mortal world by the Goddess of Fate. Its bearer shall receive the favor of destiny.
After reading it, Daniel immediately equipped it.
There was absolutely no doubt that the effect of this item was monstrously overpowered.
The first effect alone was absurd.
No matter what kind of attack he used, all of them would be calculated using the damage of his strongest offensive skill as the base.
At present, Daniel’s strongest damage skill was [Void Arrow].
It provided a 500% damage bonus, doubled again against Shadowkin targets, and when combined with guaranteed critical hits...
The damage of every arrow was now stably above three million.
It was simply so powerful that it bordered on the ridiculous.
Daniel remembered that in the Stellar World, there was also a hidden achievement.
Deal five million damage in a single hit.
And the reward for that hidden achievement was also exceptionally rare and powerful.
More importantly, it was unique.
"Five million..."
"Right now, even a casual arrow from me already deals three million."
"It won’t be long before I reach it."

sentences.text: Before the entrance to the rift, countless Shadowkin warriors continued to pour forth without end.
Avelia hovered in midair, silently looking down over everything below.
Then, in the very next moment, Avelia suddenly whipped her head toward the distance.
An incomparably familiar figure appeared before her eyes.
A look of instant dread surfaced in her gaze, and she retreated several steps in succession.
"Wh-what... what is going on?!"
"Carodion?
You... weren’t you dead?"
Avelia stared at Carodion in utter shock.

That unique divine aura belonging only to a legendary-grade powerhouse, along with the terrifying holy power surging from his body, proved beyond doubt that this was the Watcher who guarded this place—Carodion.
"What kind of joke is this?
That’s impossible!!!"
Avelia’s pupils contracted sharply.
"That’s impossible!"
She could accept Daniel escaping, because in her eyes he was nothing more than a weak and insignificant insect.
But she absolutely could not accept Carodion coming back to life.
"Wait... that fragment of remains... could that have been the doing of that little insect from before?"
"How is that even possible?
What exactly did he do?!"
"If all humans can be revived... then wouldn’t my Shadowkin become a complete joke?!"
At this moment, Avelia felt as though the world before her had become utterly unfamiliar.
And while Avelia was sinking into near-madness, Daniel slowly appeared behind Carodion.
As he looked at Carodion’s back, a trace of deep respect appeared in his eyes.
Then he fixed Avelia with a cold stare and said, "I ask that you slay this demon."
Before the final word had even fully left his mouth, Avelia already felt a violent gust rushing straight at her.
Carodion transformed into a streak of golden radiance and shot toward Avelia, the longsword in his hand erupting with divine light as though it could erase all impurity from existence.
"You’re courting death!"
Sharp claws instantly sprang from Avelia’s hands.
Boom—boom!
The moment the two figures collided, a burst of blazing sparks exploded outward.
Avelia managed to receive Carodion’s strike.
But not only was she not pleased, her heart was instead seized by overwhelming terror.
Because in that instant, she understood one thing perfectly clearly.
The Carodion before her could not possibly be some kind of fake.
Run!
That thought flashed through Avelia’s mind at once.
What kind of absurdity was this?!
Under normal circumstances, even when she and Azmodar, the two great Shadowkin lords, joined forces, they still could not do anything to Carodion.
Fight him one-on-one?
She did not think she had lived too long and grown tired of being alive.
Avelia no longer cared in the slightest about the rest of the Shadowkin soldiers still on the battlefield.
She turned and fled at once, trying to escape without hesitation.
Seeing her spin around and run without the slightest intention of fighting, Carodion gave a cold laugh.
A boundless brilliance burst from the sword in his hand.
A dazzling golden light flashed across the blade.
Then he surged forward and brought it down in a single slash.
"Secret Art—Sacred Judgment!"
Srrrip!
Pfft!
Avelia’s claws were severed by force.
At the same time, all the strength in her body seemed to be drained away in an instant.
Boom!
A beam of violet light crashed down from the heavens.
Avelia slammed brutally into the ground, blasting a massive crater into the earth.
A deep and wide wound extended from the center of her brow all the way to her abdomen.
Her body had nearly been split in two.
Avelia could no longer move.
She did not even possess the strength to open her mouth and speak.
She stared at Carodion, her eyes filled with unwillingness, despair, and utter disbelief.
"Wait a moment!"
Daniel suddenly called out, stopping Carodion just as he was about to deliver the finishing blow.
"Let me do it."
He turned to Carodion and said those words calmly.
Carodion nodded.
"As you wish, sir."
Daniel walked to a spot not far from Avelia.
He raised the Moon Reaper in his hand.
Three Aetherlances were charged and ready to fire.
The golden spears tore through the air and pierced through Avelia’s body in an instant.
Blood-red damage numbers rose above Avelia’s head.
[Void Arrow] dealt 1000% damage against abyssal Shadowkin creatures.
On top of that, with the guaranteed critical-hit effect of [Fate Stone], the damage of this one strike had reached a horrifying level of over thirty million.
At this point, the legendary-grade Shadowkin powerhouse Avelia had fallen completely.
[Ding!
You have slain the Shadowkin leader Boss · Nightmare Queen Avelia (legendary-grade)!]
[Obtained EXP +15 billion!
Obtained Contribution Points +1,000,000!]
At the same time, a server-wide announcement rang out.
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of Universe No.
616 has slain the legendary-grade Shadowkin powerhouse "Nightmare Queen · Avelia," becoming the first player to kill a legendary-grade Boss!]
[Special rewards granted to this player: Contribution Points +100,000, gold coin +100,000!]
[Special reward granted to this player: "Fate Stone (supreme-grade)"!]
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of Universe No.
616 has successfully repelled the Shadowkin invasion!
Special reward granted to this player: the unique special talent "Eternal Ring"!]
The two consecutive world announcements left players everywhere somewhat stunned.
"Wait, what?
A legendary-grade powerhouse... that’s it?"
"No, seriously, I already got my popcorn ready to watch the show, and now you’re telling me the enemy’s already on its knees??"
"Can somebody tell me where to report bugs in this game?
There is absolutely no way this Faustus is normal.
He’s definitely abusing some kind of game exploit!"
"What even is this so-called Shadowkin?
I thought they were supposed to be terrifying, but in the end they were just padding for the numbers!"
"Exactly.
The name sounded scary, but they’re probably just a few trash mobs.
Can’t be that much stronger than goblins!"
Meanwhile, the players of World 616 were so excited they could barely contain themselves.
"Invincible!
Faustus handled the Shadowkin invasion all by himself.
Tell me, who else can do that?!"
"No, hold on, I want to ask the same thing.
Has Faustus already leveled to the point where he can kill a legendary-grade Boss now???"
"Holy shit!
That was a legendary-grade enemy!
I haven’t even seen a legendary-grade Boss before!"
"Faustus is forever the one true god!"
Daniel looked at the system notification and was briefly taken aback.
What kind of item was [Fate Stone]?
In all his previous lives, he did not seem to remember ever hearing of it.
He reached into his inventory and took out the gemstone shimmering with seven-colored light.
[Fate Stone (supreme-grade)]
Effect:
All skills and attacks (including normal attacks) will use the damage value of your strongest damage-dealing skill as their base value.
After equipping this special item, all attacks are guaranteed to crit and will additionally inflict the effect [Fate Interference]!
[Fate Interference] (non-stackable): reduces all target attributes by 60%!
Description: A fragment once lost to the mortal world by the Goddess of Fate.
Its bearer shall receive the favor of destiny.
After reading it, Daniel immediately equipped it.
There was absolutely no doubt that the effect of this item was monstrously overpowered.
The first effect alone was absurd.
No matter what kind of attack he used, all of them would be calculated using the damage of his strongest offensive skill as the base.
At present, Daniel’s strongest damage skill was [Void Arrow].
It provided a 500% damage bonus, doubled again against Shadowkin targets, and when combined with guaranteed critical hits...
The damage of every arrow was now stably above three million.
It was simply so powerful that it bordered on the ridiculous.
Daniel remembered that in the Stellar World, there was also a hidden achievement.
Deal five million damage in a single hit.
And the reward for that hidden achievement was also exceptionally rare and powerful.
More importantly, it was unique.
"Five million..."
"Right now, even a casual arrow from me already deals three million."
"It won’t be long before I reach it."

chapters.title: Chapter 82 -82-Growth-Type Equipment, Stellar Wrath
paragraphs: Daniel turned his gaze to another reward in his backpack.
[Talent Scroll · Eternal Ring (Unique/SSS Grade)]
Effects:
All current buffs become [permanent]! All buffs gained henceforth will also last permanently!
All buff states are undispellable, unpurgeable, and non-transferable!
Description: The legendary Eternal Ring, capable of turning a fleeting moment into eternity!
[Prompt: Use the "Eternal Ring" talent?]
"Yes!"
[Prompt: Congratulations! You have successfully obtained the SSS-grade unique talent "Eternal Ring"!]
Daniel’s eyes widened as he scanned the talent.
The power granted by this talent was terrifyingly immense—undoubtedly a ceiling-level skill talent.
With this talent in hand... if he were to acquire some top-tier buffs, he could approach invincibility. Moreover, the buff effects would remain undispellable, unremovable, and non-transferable.
For a moment, Daniel felt a surreal sense of awe wash over him.

Since the moment of his rebirth, he had envisioned countless upgrade paths and potential plans. Yet he had never imagined reaching this stage in such an almost "cheat-like" manner—a point so unreal that even he could hardly believe it.
At level 100, he already possessed the combat power to solo over two hundred-level legendary-grade NPCs, and his supreme-grade equipment could even be sold by weight.
His skills, attributes, and all other enhancements were beyond comprehension.
Yet, he felt no unease at all. After all, the enemies he was destined to face were not something one could defeat easily. Even now, the gap between himself and his opponents remained vast.
Adjusting his mindset, Daniel turned his attention to the ground and began collecting the items dropped by Avelia.
Skyhold.
Beneath the cerulean sky, a streak of brilliant blue light suddenly shot across the heavens like a falling star, tearing through the firmament.
The light descended rapidly, stopping near the Abyssal Rift. As it dissipated, a girl appeared, clad in a deep-blue mage robe.
Her long silver-blue hair flowed gently in the wind, and her eyes were as profound as the ocean.
In her hands rested a bow embedded with an unknown gemstone, its shaft radiating faint elemental luminescence. She hovered behind Kruel, her gaze icy, slowly raising her bow.
"He carries the aura of the Abyss. He must be the one who triggered the rift’s chaos," she murmured.
Kruel remained oblivious to the approach behind him, still immersed in the euphoria of completing the quest, a grin of unrestrained pride tugging at his lips.
"This SSS-grade quest... I finally finished it," he whispered excitedly. "Once I turn it in, that hidden-class goblin will be mine!"
"I just wonder... how strong it will be. Surely not stronger than Faustus, right? After all, it’s an SSS-grade quest... Faustus probably hasn’t even seen one."
At that moment, a pale cyan light descended from the sky, enveloping him completely.
[Ding! You are affected by the god-grade sealing skill "Law of the Wind Lock"! You cannot move, cast spells, or use any items!]
Kruel’s grin froze instantly.
Through his vision, the figure of the blue-haired mage gradually emerged.
The mage simply waved her hand, and Kruel vanished with her, leaving no trace as if he had never existed.
Abyssal Rift Entrance.
Daniel’s eyes swept over the spoils scattered from Avelia’s defeat. He began methodically clearing the battlefield, routing each item through the guild warehouse.
[Ding! You sold an item to Doom Guild: Meteor Flame skill book, 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[You have enabled default Quality Boost!]
[Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin and the forbidden curse skill book: Skyfall (supreme-grade)!]
Daniel opened the skill book, feeling the searing heat emanate from its pages.
[Skyfall Strike (SSS-grade Forbidden Curse)]
Learning Restriction: Archer / Level 150
Effect:

Calls down meteors from beyond the heavens to strike a target area (1000×1000 meters). Each meteor deals 5000% damage, with the number of meteors depending on Intelligence (1 additional meteor per 1000 Intelligence, up to 100 meteors).
Upon impact, meteors explode with a 50-meter radius, dealing an extra 2000% damage and leaving a persistent burning zone on the ground for 60 seconds.
Cooldown: 10 minutes
MP Cost: 10,000
Description: One of the forbidden curses of the legendary Arrow God, said to bring apocalypse upon casting, reducing all to ruin.
Daniel’s breath hitched.
A forbidden curse—and an SSS-grade forbidden curse at that. He knew better than anyone what that meant.
His passive profession trait caused every single shot to be equivalent to five simultaneous shots, with no cooldown delay.
This meant that casting this forbidden curse once would unleash five simultaneous forbidden curses.
With all his enhancements and equipment effects stacked, Daniel shook his head in disbelief, moving on to the next item.
[Ding! You sold an item to Doom Guild: Starlight Whisperer (legendary-grade), 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin and the equipment: Stellar Wrath (supreme-grade)!]
[Stellar Wrath (supreme-grade bow)]
Grade: Supreme
Special Property: Growth-capable
Attack Power: 5000 (scales with level)
Equipment Effects:
Agility +500 (scales with weapon level)
Grants the skill [Starlight Barrier]: randomly summons an elemental shield, covering the user, absorbing 500,000 damage, and granting immunity to all control effects while active.
Every time a forbidden curse is cast, its effects double (damage, range, duration).
All archer class skills receive +100% effect.
[More skills unlockable as weapon levels up]
Durability: Infinite (supreme-grade equipment cannot break)

Description: A supreme-grade masterpiece forged in the twilight years of the Arrow God Aranas. It contains the very essence of the falling stars, with a bow shaft shimmering like the dawn of the cosmos. Arrows shot from it can summon celestial wrath and rend the skies.
Daniel stared at the bow, finally exhaling.
Agility boost, a half-million damage absorption shield, immunity to control effects, forbidden curse doubling... it embodied virtually everything he could imagine.
And even more powerful abilities awaited unlocking.
This was an extremely rare, upgradeable weapon.

The Moon Reaper he had relied on was only legendary-grade, inferior in many ways compared to this supreme-grade bow. Though Moon Reaper could also be upgraded, its attack power increase was the only improvement—it lacked additional effects.
Yet Daniel had never encountered any enemy that demanded he expend every ounce of effort and still could not win. That was why he had continued using his beginner bow all this time.
Now, with a perfect, high-tier replacement, he finally replaced the Moon Reaper.
"Too bad... maxing it out will take quite some effort," he muttered.
The moment the bow entered his hands, a warm celestial energy spread from his palm throughout his body, as if the entire starry sky were whispering directly to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 -83-Endless Despair Potion, Overwhelming Debt
paragraphs: Daniel’s eyes fell on the final item.
[Ding! You sold an item to Doom Guild: Potion of Agony (legendary-grade), 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin and the potion: Endless Despair (supreme-grade)!]
[Endless Despair (supreme-grade potion)]
Effect: Upon consumption, killing a target player automatically grants 100% of their gold coins, and applies the [Eternal Debt] effect.

[Eternal Debt]: The target player’s gold coin amount is further reduced by 1000%, and all future gold coins obtained by the target will be 100% transferred to the killer until the debt is fully repaid. During the debt period, the target’s shop purchase privileges are temporarily suspended.
Duration: 24 hours
Description: What is true suffering? Death? No—it is a debt that can never be fully repaid.
Daniel read the potion’s description and felt a chill run down his spine.
Such a vicious potion, combined with his [Eternal Ring] talent...
...meant that every player who died at his hands would forever carry a debt.
He drew a deep breath, lifted the potion, and drained it in a single gulp.
The bitter liquid slid down his throat, carrying an ancient aura, as if drawn from the very depths of the Abyss.
[Ding! You have successfully consumed "Endless Despair"! Your status bar has been updated.]
He opened his status panel.
[Endless Debt BUFF]: After killing a player, automatically acquire 100% of their gold coins, plus an additional 1000%, and apply the [Eternal Debt] effect.
Current Buff Duration: [Permanent] (effect granted by the Eternal Ring talent)
Daniel stared at the buff and couldn’t help but let out a laugh.
He could easily imagine the expressions of hostile players being stripped bare and utterly humiliated by this effect.
After handling the loot, Daniel turned to Carodion.
This time, he owed the watcher a debt of gratitude.
Without Carodion’s strength, he would never have been able to so easily slay a legendary-grade being like Avelia.
He understood his current situation clearly:
In version 1.0, legendary-grade powers represented the absolute ceiling of strength in this world.
Even the weakest among them would be difficult for him to confront directly with his current power.
Self-preservation? Easy. Victory? Far from guaranteed.
The road to becoming truly strong still lay ahead.
Carodion stood quietly to the side, like a millennia-old iceberg.
He retained all his former strength, but had lost all memories.
For now, he was merely Daniel’s follower, acting solely according to the will of their contract.
At that moment, a brilliant blue figure slowly emerged from the void.
"Hm? Where are the shadowkin?"
"And Avelia and Azmodar?"
The azure light faded, revealing the form of a young female mage.
[Archmage · Louise (??? – legendary-grade)]
She surveyed the cratered entrance to the rift, her mind swirling with questions.
News of the rift’s chaos and the shadowkin invasion had shaken the entire Human Empire. She had been sent as one of the empire’s reinforcements.
Yet the scene before her was entirely different from her expectations.
The ground was littered with the corpses of shadowkin.
The aura of the legendary-grade shadowkin had vanished completely, and even the rift’s exit had been blown apart.
Her gaze quickly settled on Daniel and Carodion.
When she recognized the white-clad figure, her body trembled, and her pupils shrank in shock.
"Lord Carodion!"
She called out, astonished. "You... you’re alive?"
Carodion ignored her cry, staring coldly at her instead.
A heavy dread settled in Louise’s chest.
She had known Carodion for many years, yet this version... felt entirely unfamiliar.
Her gaze then shifted to Daniel.
Daniel studied the suddenly appearing mage.
From his past lives, he knew that anyone capable of hovering in the air and traversing the void must be a legendary-grade powerhouse.
Legendary-grade beings enjoyed long lifespans and ageless appearances, and though the girl appeared young, her true age likely surpassed imagination.
Louise fixed her gaze on Daniel and asked gravely:
"Lord Carodion... what exactly is going on?"
Daniel did not withhold anything, explaining the entire sequence of events.
After listening, Louise remained silent for a long moment.
"I see..." she murmured softly.
"The crisis that shook the entire empire... has been resolved by a single person."
Her eyes toward Daniel reflected a mixture of emotions: awe, relief, and a hint of concern.
"It is fortunate that the Human race has a genius like you... but..."
She paused, her tone turning grave.
"You must be careful in the future. The Shadow Council will hate you with a vengeance. They will spare no effort to take your life."

The Shadow Council had even managed to ambush top legendary-grade powers like Carodion. Against someone like Daniel, who had not yet entered the legendary-grade realm, their methods would be even more insidious.
"With Lord Carodion by my side," Daniel said calmly,
"they will at least hesitate."
Daniel knew the Shadow Council better than anyone.
This organization was the nemesis of nearly all human players, founded by human traitors with the sole goal of overthrowing the Human Empire.
Within the council lurked many high-ranking officials and legendary-grade powers.
Unfortunately, in his past lives, Daniel had only encountered mid-level operatives, and his clues about the high-level traitors within the empire were far too sparse.
Later, when the entire Human Empire fell, he had no time to investigate who truly controlled the Shadow Council.
At that moment, Louise suddenly raised her hand, pointing toward Kruel, who remained immobilized by divine magic.
Kruel could only stare at the two of them, unable to act.
"This man is a pawn of the Shadow Council. He can be left in your hands," she said.
As her words fell, a system prompt sounded in Daniel’s ear.
[Ding! You triggered a random quest: "Clean Up the Pawn." Accept?]
A glint of determination sparked in Daniel’s eyes.
"Accept."
[Ding! You have accepted the quest: "Clean Up the Pawn"!]
[Quest Difficulty: D]
[Objective: Kill the pawn of the Shadow Council mastermind.]

[Quest Description: During the rift chaos, non-human races allied with the Shadow Council, using the [Spear of Dalik] to aid in the assassination of Human Watcher Carodion. Their plot has been foiled, but you must strike back decisively!]
[Quest Reward: Louise’s favor, Louise’s summoning crystal.]
Daniel closed the quest panel and lifted Stellar Wrath.
Golden light condensed at the tip—Arrow of Divine Radiance!
With a gaze full of fury, a light arrow shot straight through Kruel’s body.
Critical hit!
This was Kruel’s HP maximum, not Daniel’s limit.
[Ding! You killed the player "Kruel"!]
[Endless Debt BUFF triggered! Acquired 100% of "Kruel"’s gold coins! Target afflicted with "Eternal Debt," owing you 100w gold coins!]
A slight smile lifted Daniel’s lips.
"100w gold coins... principal of 10w? Not bad... this guy’s pretty rich!"

[Endless Debt BUFF]: After killing a player, automatically acquire 100% of their gold coins, plus an additional 1000%, and apply the [Eternal Debt] effect.
Current Buff Duration: [Permanent] (effect granted by the Eternal Ring talent)
Daniel stared at the buff and couldn’t help but let out a laugh.
He could easily imagine the expressions of hostile players being stripped bare and utterly humiliated by this effect.
After handling the loot, Daniel turned to Carodion.
This time, he owed the watcher a debt of gratitude.
Without Carodion’s strength, he would never have been able to so easily slay a legendary-grade being like Avelia.
He understood his current situation clearly:
In version 1.0, legendary-grade powers represented the absolute ceiling of strength in this world.
Even the weakest among them would be difficult for him to confront directly with his current power.
Self-preservation?
Easy.
Victory?
Far from guaranteed.
The road to becoming truly strong still lay ahead.
Carodion stood quietly to the side, like a millennia-old iceberg.
He retained all his former strength, but had lost all memories.
For now, he was merely Daniel’s follower, acting solely according to the will of their contract.
At that moment, a brilliant blue figure slowly emerged from the void.
"Hm?
Where are the shadowkin?"
"And Avelia and Azmodar?"
The azure light faded, revealing the form of a young female mage.
[Archmage · Louise (??? – legendary-grade)]
She surveyed the cratered entrance to the rift, her mind swirling with questions.
News of the rift’s chaos and the shadowkin invasion had shaken the entire Human Empire.
She had been sent as one of the empire’s reinforcements.
Yet the scene before her was entirely different from her expectations.
The ground was littered with the corpses of shadowkin.
The aura of the legendary-grade shadowkin had vanished completely, and even the rift’s exit had been blown apart.
Her gaze quickly settled on Daniel and Carodion.
When she recognized the white-clad figure, her body trembled, and her pupils shrank in shock.
"Lord Carodion!"
She called out, astonished.
"You... you’re alive?"
Carodion ignored her cry, staring coldly at her instead.
A heavy dread settled in Louise’s chest.
She had known Carodion for many years, yet this version... felt entirely unfamiliar.
Her gaze then shifted to Daniel.
Daniel studied the suddenly appearing mage.
From his past lives, he knew that anyone capable of hovering in the air and traversing the void must be a legendary-grade powerhouse.
Legendary-grade beings enjoyed long lifespans and ageless appearances, and though the girl appeared young, her true age likely surpassed imagination.
Louise fixed her gaze on Daniel and asked gravely:
"Lord Carodion... what exactly is going on?"
Daniel did not withhold anything, explaining the entire sequence of events.
After listening, Louise remained silent for a long moment.
"I see..." she murmured softly.
"The crisis that shook the entire empire... has been resolved by a single person."
Her eyes toward Daniel reflected a mixture of emotions: awe, relief, and a hint of concern.
"It is fortunate that the Human race has a genius like you... but..."
She paused, her tone turning grave.
"You must be careful in the future.
The Shadow Council will hate you with a vengeance.
They will spare no effort to take your life."
The Shadow Council had even managed to ambush top legendary-grade powers like Carodion.
Against someone like Daniel, who had not yet entered the legendary-grade realm, their methods would be even more insidious.
"With Lord Carodion by my side," Daniel said calmly,
"they will at least hesitate."
Daniel knew the Shadow Council better than anyone.
This organization was the nemesis of nearly all human players, founded by human traitors with the sole goal of overthrowing the Human Empire.
Within the council lurked many high-ranking officials and legendary-grade powers.
Unfortunately, in his past lives, Daniel had only encountered mid-level operatives, and his clues about the high-level traitors within the empire were far too sparse.
Later, when the entire Human Empire fell, he had no time to investigate who truly controlled the Shadow Council.
At that moment, Louise suddenly raised her hand, pointing toward Kruel, who remained immobilized by divine magic.
Kruel could only stare at the two of them, unable to act.
"This man is a pawn of the Shadow Council.
He can be left in your hands," she said.
As her words fell, a system prompt sounded in Daniel’s ear.
[Ding!
You triggered a random quest: "Clean Up the Pawn." Accept?]
A glint of determination sparked in Daniel’s eyes.
"Accept."
[Ding!
You have accepted the quest: "Clean Up the Pawn"!]
[Quest Difficulty: D]
[Objective: Kill the pawn of the Shadow Council mastermind.]
[Quest Description: During the rift chaos, non-human races allied with the Shadow Council, using the [Spear of Dalik] to aid in the assassination of Human Watcher Carodion.
Their plot has been foiled, but you must strike back decisively!]
[Quest Reward: Louise’s favor, Louise’s summoning crystal.]
Daniel closed the quest panel and lifted Stellar Wrath.
Golden light condensed at the tip—Arrow of Divine Radiance!
With a gaze full of fury, a light arrow shot straight through Kruel’s body.
Critical hit!
This was Kruel’s HP maximum, not Daniel’s limit.
[Ding!
You killed the player "Kruel"!]
[Endless Debt BUFF triggered!
Acquired 100% of "Kruel"’s gold coins!
Target afflicted with "Eternal Debt," owing you 100w gold coins!]
A slight smile lifted Daniel’s lips.
"100w gold coins... principal of 10w?
Not bad... this guy’s pretty rich!"

chapters.title: Chapter 84 -84-Debt of 1,000,000? Just Delete Your Account and Start Over!
paragraphs: Somewhere in a goblin tribe’s respawn point.
Kruel staggered out of the portal, his entire being seeming hollow, as if his soul had been stripped away.
His lips twitched repeatedly, mumbling the same number over and over:
"One million... one million... one million..."
The system prompts from a minute ago continued to echo relentlessly in his mind:
[Ding~ You were killed by the player "Faustus." Death Curse BUFF triggered! Current level -5!]
[Ding~ You were killed by the player "Faustus." Death Curse BUFF triggered! Forced drop of 7 pieces of equipment!]
[Ding~ You were killed by the player "Faustus." Death Curse BUFF triggered! All items in your backpack forcibly dropped!]
He had thought that was the absolute nightmare.
But the next prompt struck like a sledgehammer, shattering his fragile mind.

[Ding~ You were killed by the player "Faustus." Endless Debt BUFF triggered! "Eternal Debt" effect applied! All gold coins you gain will automatically transfer to "Faustus," totaling a debt of 1,000,000 gold coins!]
Kruel stood dumbfounded, counting the zeros over and over.
Then he realized the cruel truth.
After being killed by Faustus, he actually owed him one million gold coins?
"Pfft—!"
A mouthful of blood spat out.
[Ding! You are currently under "Fate Interference" status, losing 200 HP!]
Kruel: "..."
He suddenly recalled a joke circulating on the forums recently.
It was about the extraordinarily brutal level-down and loot explosion after being killed by Faustus.
Some players had angrily shouted:
"Stop pretending! Death-hook dog, just take everything from my backpack if you want!"
Now it had happened... Faustus really was here.
Not only was everything in the backpack gone, but all future earnings were gone too!
That 100,000 gold coins had taken him weeks of grinding, completing hidden quests to earn, and now... all gone.
And now, on top of it, he owed even more!
1,000,000 gold coins!
Worse, repayment was prioritized. Every task reward, every sale would automatically go toward settling the debt.
What kind of game was this?!
For a long moment, Kruel was on the verge of tears, frantically searching the system panel for the "delete account and start over" option...
Abyssal Rift.
[Ding! You have completed the quest: "Eliminate the Pawn of the Mastermind"!]
[Millionfold Boost triggered! Louise’s favor toward you has reached maximum!]
Louise regarded Daniel, her eyes full of admiration.
"Well done. This belongs to you," she said.
A silver-white crystal orb appeared in her hand, floating in the air. She extended it toward Daniel.
"If you ever face danger, you can use this to summon me."
Daniel took the crystal.
[Louise’s Summoning Crystal (Single-use)]
Effect: Summons the legendary-grade powerhouse "Louise" to assist in battle.

Description: Louise greatly admires you and worries that you may be targeted by the Shadow Council in the future. If you face a life-threatening situation, this crystal can summon her for aid—though it can only be used once.
Daniel placed the crystal in his backpack.
Although usable only once, having it was better than nothing.
Louise turned her gaze to the still-turbulent rift, her voice calm but tinged with gravity.
"It won’t be long before this rift self-stabilizes. When that happens, new shadowkin legendary-grade powers will appear."
"If all goes as expected... I will take over from Lord Carodion and become the new Watcher here."
Daniel froze slightly.
A Watcher was supposed to be one of the Human race’s top-tier powers, wasn’t it?
Had Louise already reached that level?
She seemed to read his thoughts and replied lightly:
"During rift disturbances, many Watchers suffered casualties. Few now remain capable of this role. While the seal can still be maintained, it is done out of necessity, not choice."
She let out a bitter laugh, gazing into the distance.
"Our human race cannot endure another major upheaval. If the rift opens again and the shadowkin invade en masse... humanity will face catastrophe."
Daniel nodded, a trace of worry passing through his eyes.
After a brief conversation, the two parted ways.
Daniel stood alone at the edge of the rift, staring into the bottomless chasm, feeling a weight unlike anything before.
Non-human races besieging them, the Shadow Council plotting to overthrow the empire...
Compared to the calamities that would come later, these were but minor skirmishes.
When future world disasters continued to strike in successive game versions... humanity would truly teeter on the brink.
To change any of this, one must possess absolute Strength capable of suppressing all threats.
He thought of [Seraphic Revival].
The forbidden art capable of reviving legendary-grade powers was one of his strongest trump cards.
Yet precisely because of its power, it must remain a secret.
The Shadow Council harbored countless human traitors, and even among the player base they had planted spies.
If they learned he possessed such Strength, the human traitors would undoubtedly surround and attack him without mercy.
With his current power, facing one or two legendary-grade foes was manageable.
But if they used exotic items, or dispatched multiple legendary-grade powers simultaneously...
Daniel’s expression darkened.
At present, the only one aware that Carodion had revived was Louise.
And he had not disclosed the full details of [Seraphic Revival] to her, only describing it as "a revival item."
Although extremely rare, the revival item was not unique. It could be made public without danger.
The key was never using the forbidden art publicly, lest the shocking power to infinitely revive legendary-grade beings... alarm everyone.
Compared to other restricted resurrection methods, it was simply too terrifying.
"Even so... I’m still not strong enough," Daniel murmured, gripping his bow.
"If I could become powerful enough to crush all legendary-grade foes, I could protect everything I wish to safeguard in this version."
At that moment, an announcement reverberated across the entire Stellar world, interrupting his thoughts.
[Server-wide Announcement!!!]
[Currently, 10 billion players have reached level 15 or above! System level ranking officially activated! The top three players will receive special rewards!]
[Server-wide Announcement!!!]
["Battle of Desperation" will commence in 10 minutes! All players above level 15, prepare!]
Daniel’s spirits lifted.
Battle of Desperation!
In past lives, it was called a prelude to the World War, a warm-up before the true climactic battle of the world line.
He lifted his gaze to the distant horizon, a cold curve curling at the corner of his lips.
"Scum of World District 1213... your debts from past lives... this time, you won’t escape!"

chapters.title: Chapter 85 -85-Upon the Throne, Uproar Among the Masses
paragraphs: [Level Rankings]
Faustus; [Level 100]; World District 616
White-Headed Fierce Eagle; [Level 79]; World District 616
Rhine Watcher; [Level 79]; World District 616
Song of Faith; [Level 75]; World District 250
Shadow Wolf; [Level 75]; World District 1213
Thunder’s Wrath; [Level 75]; World District 666
Duskfang; [Level 75]; World District 616
Windstrider; [Level 75]; World District 520
Holy Light Prayer; [Level 75]; World District 250
Sunborn; [Level 75]; World District 616
Daniel’s gaze swept over the top ten, then traveled further down the list.
Top five thousand, top ten thousand...
He closed the ranking, a faint, almost imperceptible curve tugging at the corner of his lips.
In past lives, World District 616 had been strong, yes—but only slightly superior to other districts. Hardly enough to inspire awe.
Yet now, half of the top ten thousand ranks were occupied by players from World District 616.
And among the top ten, half of the seats were held firmly by 616’s strongest.
What did this mean?
It meant that World District 616, acting as a single world force, could contend with the entire Stellar player base.
Daniel looked at the familiar names and felt an inexplicable sense of satisfaction.
All the experience shared freely, the cheap high-grade equipment, and the resources... had not been wasted.
Players from World District 616 had utilized them fully, climbing step by step to the pinnacle. This outcome was entirely expected.
Had they developed as in previous lives, it would have seemed unnatural.
As he contemplated this, a system prompt arrived as expected.
[Ding! Your level ranking reward has been distributed. Please check your inventory.]
Daniel opened his backpack and saw a badge glowing with soft golden light.
[Congratulations! You have obtained the title: Upon the Throne (supreme-grade)!]
[Upon the Throne (supreme-grade title)]
Effects:
Wearing this title increases all four core attributes by 2000 points.
Wearing this title grants unlimited backpack space, and items inside will never drop.
All skill cooldowns are halved.
Grants the skill: [supreme-grade Purification]—immune to all control and negative statuses for 5 minutes.
Description: A pioneer above all living beings, bearing the responsibility of charting the course of the world!
Daniel stared at the title’s attributes, lightly tapping it in the void.
[Ding! You have equipped the title "Upon the Throne".]
The 2,000-point boost to his four core attributes elevated his already terrifying output even further.
The convenience of an unlimited backpack might seem trivial, but at critical moments it removed countless complications.
And the five-minute cooldown Purification skill, combined with the passive immunity from his [Demon’s Whisper] mask, formed an impermeable defensive barrier.
From now on, no control skill could affect him for even an instant.
He closed the panel and turned his gaze to the distant horizon, where a faint outline of the battlefield could be seen.
"Once the Battle of Desperation ends, I’ll go hunt for some powerful buff potions," he thought.
The [Eternal Ring] made all buffs permanent, and Millionfold Boost could elevate ordinary potions to extraordinary quality.
By then, his strength would soar once more.
But that was for later.
For now, there was only one thing to do.
Daniel raised his eyes, glancing at the system panel where a countdown ticked away.
Five minutes remaining.
The moment the level rankings appeared, the entire Stellar world shook.
Players from every world scoured the leaderboard for their own names, desperate to see their place in this stellar contest.
Then... they saw Faustus at the top.
The entire multi-world channel fell into deathly silence.
Level 100!
The number behind the name was like an invisible iron hammer, pounding the chest of every player.
Level 100—what did it mean?
The vast majority of players were still struggling in the thirties and forties, while this man stood in a realm far beyond their reach.
This was no longer a lead. It was crushing domination, a chasm, an insurmountable divide.
And when their eyes left the top rank and scanned the second, third, fourth... all the way to the tenth, a bone-chilling fear crept up their spines.
Half of the top ten were from World District 616!
How was this possible?
Some trembling fingers continued scrolling—past hundreds, past thousands, past ten thousand... until they froze completely.
Among the top ten thousand, nearly five thousand names bore the same tag:
[World District 616]
A shared thought arose in countless minds simultaneously:
Wasn’t the Battle of Desperation supposed to be a multi-world melee? With this... can we even compete?
Wait... if we surrender early, can we at least lose only half?
[Multi-World Channel]
Players from World District 250 broke the silence first, voices filled with fervor and outrage:
"I call upon the powers of all worlds to unite against World District 616! They’ve broken the balance of the game with blatant cheating!"
Players from World District 1213 stoked the fire:
"That’s right! Led by Faustus, District 616 is essentially cheating across the board. How are we supposed to play?"
Players from World District 600’s frustration surged further:
"We cannot tolerate any one world dominating! This is an insult to fairness and to all players!"
Players from District 250 raised their arms, rallying in the Multi-World Channel:
"Unite! In this secret Battle of Desperation, we must band together against the players of World District 616! If the GMs won’t stop their cheats, we’ll handle the cancer ourselves!"
"Indeed, cheating is rampant in World District 616—it’s a disaster of a place."
"Yes, it’s time to teach them a lesson."
"When the time comes, let’s see how our District 1213 players make them log off crying for their moms! Hahaha!"
Occasionally, a player from District 616 would attempt to protest:
"Our strength is real. We’re not cheating!"
But these voices were instantly drowned out by the overwhelming wave of accusations.
Meanwhile, in World District 616’s own channel, the atmosphere burned even hotter:
"Brothers, looks like the whole world is gunning for us this time."
"What are we afraid of? Kill them all, no matter how many!"
"Exactly. That mighty Dwarf Warrior? We crushed him without effort. Under Faustus’s lead, we will slaughter anyone in our path!"
"They dare accuse us of cheating? Laughable excuse. Even if the world stands against us, I believe... we will prevail!"

"Brothers, looks like the whole world is gunning for us this time."
"What are we afraid of?
Kill them all, no matter how many!"
"Exactly.
That mighty Dwarf Warrior?
We crushed him without effort.
Under Faustus’s lead, we will slaughter anyone in our path!"
"They dare accuse us of cheating?
Laughable excuse.
Even if the world stands against us, I believe... we will prevail!"

chapters.title: Chapter 86 -86-Tickling? Not Even a Scratch
paragraphs: Time flowed amid the clamor.
[Ding! Attention all players! The server-wide event "Battle of Desperation" has officially begun!]
[Tip: Click the event interface button to teleport directly to the battlefield.]
[Tip: In the secret realm Battle of Desperation, eliminated players cannot re-enter. Global synchronized live streaming is now active. All players can spectate, send bullet comments, and tip.]
[Tip: Killing enemy-zone players or completing stage objectives earns Battle of Desperation points, which can be exchanged for various items in the shop.]
[Tip: In Battle of Desperation, all monsters only drop items—not equipment, experience, skill books, or gold coins. Killing players from other world zones grants all these rewards.]
[Tip: Upon entering Battle of Desperation, your attack mode is automatically set to area mode. You cannot damage players from your own world zone.]
Daniel listened to each prompt, expression calm and unchanged.
The rules were no different from his previous lives.
He opened the event interface and lightly tapped the teleport button.
A flash of white light engulfed everything.
When his vision cleared, Daniel found himself standing on unfamiliar land.
The air was tinged with faint smoke and the metallic tang of blood. The distant horizon was shrouded in a grayish haze.

[Ding! You have been automatically assigned to World District 616. Initial login count for District 616: 1.09 billion. System rating for District 616 combat power: SSS-grade! Secret realm quest difficulty automatically adjusted to SSS-grade!]
[Tip: All District 616 players completing the event will receive SSS-grade rewards.]
[Tip: You have entered the Battle of Desperation battlefield. Current area: MC-8848 Teleport Zone.]
[Tip: Map updated. Follow guidance to reach your district’s castle. Wild monsters appear en route. Players must exercise caution.]
Daniel was about to open the map when a flurry of rapid prompts sounded in his ear.
[Tip: You are now in combat! You are under attack by the player "Golden Windblade"!]
[Tip: You are now in combat! You are under attack by the player "The Silent One"!]
[Tip: You are now in combat! You are under attack by the player "von Klein"!]
Simultaneously, a stream of trivial damage numbers floated above his head:
"MISS!"
"MISS!"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
He looked up to see dozens of foreign-world players surrounding him, unloading torrents of attacks.
Flashes of skill light exploded across his form, yet they struck like waves against a cliff, unable to even scratch the surface of his armor.
Nearly 20,000 points in his four core attributes, combined with the 50% absolute evasion from his Windstrider Robe, made the attacks of these thirty- to forty-level players laughably ineffective.
Yet the attackers’ reactions were even more stunned.
"By the gods! What kind of monster is this?"
"All damage is forced? How is this possible?"
"Forty-plus people attacking one, and each hit deals only one point of damage? I must be seeing things!"
"Look at his title! Upon the Throne... Rising Star of the Empire? Holy Shit!"
"Faustus... he’s Faustus! The one-man city slayer Faustus!"
"No! Wait, run... RUN!"
Daniel’s eyes glinted with icy killing intent.
Planning to strike and run?
Suicide!
He raised his hand, but the scene before him only sharpened his intent.
Within MC-8848 Teleport Zone, countless foreign-world players were ruthlessly slaughtering District 616 players.
They struck with no mercy, treating the humans not as fellow players, but as enemies to be annihilated.
Some had just landed, barely taking in their surroundings before being overwhelmed by a deluge of skills.
Others fought desperately, killing one or two opponents, only to be instantly focused down by dozens.
Those attempting to flee found enemies on all sides—escape was impossible.
The resistance of District 616 seemed fragile and feeble against this premeditated coalition.
Clearly, this was a carefully orchestrated encirclement.
Daniel’s gaze swept across the battlefield of carnage, his fingers slowly brushing against the string of Stellar Wrath.
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The moment the Battle of Desperation began, global live streaming activated.
Billions of viewers poured into the most popular player streams, bullet comments flooding like a tidal wave.
"They’re here! Battle of Desperation has started!"
"Check the level rankings! Faustus is Level 100! How are the opponents supposed to fight him?"
"Level 100? With so many worlds united, a single spit could drown him!"
"Exactly! District 616 is doomed this time!"
"MC-8848 Teleport Zone! Faustus is there! Look—"
"My gods, so many attacking him! Dozens against one!"
"Wait... all forced damage? All -1?!"
"What... what kind of defense is this? Cheating, right?!"
Faustus: "Are you tickling me?"
The chat exploded, and under the gaze of billions...
Daniel moved.
Within the teleport zone, Daniel unfurled his Black Dragon Wings.
Ten-meter-wide obsidian wings spread behind him, each feather gleaming with a cold metallic sheen.
He leapt into the air, surveying the chaos below.
Stellar Wrath was drawn taut.
The bowstring vibrated, and a golden arrow tore through the sky, ascending toward the clouds.
Whum—!
[Arrowstorm!]
[Shattering Comet!]
Two devastating SSS-grade skills ignited simultaneously.
At the peak, the arrow exploded, fracturing into thousands of golden streaks, like shattered stars, cascading like a galactic waterfall.
Simultaneously, a torrential arrow rain fell from the clouds, merging with the scattering streaks.
In an instant, the sky was filled with golden light.
Each arrow trailing blazing streaks, each imbued with Strength capable of tearing steel.
Then...
BOOOOM! BOOOOM!
The ground shook violently.
The roar of explosions merged into a deafening chorus, golden fire consuming everything in moments.
Shockwaves overturned all living beings within hundreds of meters.
The earth cracked, stones flew, and the air shimmered with scorching heat.
The foreign-world coalition attacking District 616 hadn’t even realized what had happened—they were shredded like paper under the golden storm of arrows.
When the dust cleared, the area was empty.
[Ding! You have killed ×3,794 foreign-world players!]
[Death Curse BUFF triggered! Targets level -5! Forced drop of equipment! Forced drop of all backpack items!]
[Endless Debt BUFF triggered! Acquired 100% of targets’ gold coins! Targets afflicted with Eternal Debt!]
The ground glimmered with scattered gold, equipment, and materials, sparkling brilliantly in the sunlight.

chapters.title: Chapter 87 -87-Hunting? Defense Already Shattered
paragraphs: The entire teleport zone fell into a deathly silence.
The foreign-world coalition that had been hunting District 616 players froze mid-action, their bodies stiffening as they all turned toward the figure hovering in the sky.
A silver-white scarf fluttered in the wind, jet-black dragon wings slowly beating behind him, and the longbow in his hands gleamed with pale moonlight.
Daniel’s expression was chiseled like a blade. There was no rage, no frenzy—only a frozen, absolute calm.
It was as if the three thousand-plus enemies before him were mere specks of dust, easily brushed away.
[Faustus · Lv100 · Upon the Throne]
"Fa... Faustus..."
A trembling whisper emerged from somewhere, saturated with fear.
Then, as if repelled by an invisible force, hundreds of foreign-world players simultaneously turned and fled in every direction.
"Devil! He’s a devil!"
"Devil my foot—that’s cheating, no doubt! Let’s see how they spin this one!"
"Forget whether he’s cheating—the problem is we’re locked! Holy shit, who can get up there and stop him?"
"Damn it, my friend just messaged me. Being killed by Faustus makes you lose levels and equipment! This cheat dog is insane!"
"I don’t want to drop levels! I don’t want to lose gear!"
"Gods, save me!"
Daniel’s lips curved slightly, yet there was no trace of amusement in his eyes.
He unfurled his dragon wings; his figure became a black lightning bolt.
God Speed!
In the next moment, he appeared in the densest cluster of fleeing players.
[Arrowstorm!]
A golden rain of arrows poured down again, toppling hundreds more.
Activating God Speed, he reappeared in another direction.
[Void Arrow!]
Arrows charged with elemental power pierced through the crowd, detonating at a distance and sending dust swirling into the sky.
Again, hundreds fell without resistance.
Over the next few minutes, Daniel’s figure flashed across the battlefield repeatedly.
Every appearance brought a torrential arrowstorm, each taking down hundreds of lives.
From above, he was like a bolt of black lightning weaving through a fleeing crowd.
Wherever he passed, golden light and scattered loot littered the ground.
Three minutes.
Just three minutes.
Within the MC-8848 Teleport Zone, not a single foreign-world player survived.
The rescued District 616 players stood dumbfounded, staring at the golden-strewn battlefield and the slowly descending black figure, their minds blank.
Some murmured, "Is... is it over?"
Others trembled in disbelief:
"Faustus, alone... three minutes... killed thousands... wait, almost ten thousand, right??"
Some laughed out loud, joy mingled with relief at surviving the massacre.
"Stop standing there! Help the god pick up the loot!"
Over two thousand District 616 players snapped out of their stupor, cheering as they charged toward the golden battlefield.
"Long live Faustus!"
"Long live World District 616!"
"Let those foreign-world scum see what happens when they mess with us!"
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The chat exploded.
"Cheat dog, die!"
"By the gods! Three minutes, one person, nearly ten thousand kills!"
"Those were all players, not ordinary mobs!"
Faustus: "So you want to gang up on me?"
"Hahaha... after this battle, the foreign-world players will have nightmares."
"Lose 5 levels, drop gear, empty backpack and gold coins... who can survive that?"
"One death here basically means delete your account and start over. Faustus isn’t playing, he’s committing genocide!"
"District 616 players: Thanks to Faustus for the loot package!"
Billions of viewers stared at the hovering figure on-screen, a chill running from their feet to their minds.
The voices that had clamored to unite against District 616 were now completely silenced.
Unite? How could they?
Dozens attacking one target—each hit -1.
Thousands wiped out in three minutes.
And the ease with which he executed it, the contemptuous gaze... cut deep into every foreign-world player’s soul.
How could anyone fight such an enemy?
[Ding! You killed the player "Rod," gaining 100 Battle Points!]
[Ding! You have killed over 10,000 players, earning the secret realm achievement: "Slaughterer"!]
Daniel had grown up in the cruelest wars of his past life.
He had witnessed countless calamities, countless comrades falling, his hands soaked in blood.
Over two centuries, his heart had been tempered to solid rock.
So now, as he slaughtered the foreign-world players, he felt no hesitation whatsoever.
Yet, throughout the pursuit, one thought lingered deep in his mind:
In the other areas of this secret realm, District 616 players were likely being besieged by coalition forces as well.
Those who survived to reach the castle would likely be less than one in ten.
This was well within his expectations.
In previous lives, District 616 players often suffered under coalitions led by World District 250.
In this life, the players’ power was even stronger, so the assaults would be even more frenzied.
Daniel’s eyes darkened; his bow-hand drew faster.
[Ding! You have killed over 100,000 players, earning the secret realm achievement: "Overwhelming Force"!]
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The chat erupted like a tidal wave; spectators spammed comments frantically.
"Insane! Insane!!"
"Kill these idiots who can’t handle it—Faustus is invincible!"
"These foreign-world scum can’t play fair, so they all die!"
"Well done! Faustus, dealing with them without leaving a single one!"
"Too strong... Faustus’s MP can’t be running out, right? This arrowstorm hasn’t stopped! By the gods!"
"Human-shaped auto-arrow towers? Or infinite ammo ones?"
Meanwhile, in World District 616’s channel, the atmosphere was entirely different.
Eliminated players opened the secret realm interface, switching their view to surviving players.
Seeing the horror that befell those who had just teleported in—wiped out by the foreign coalition—their fury nearly burned through their screens.
"These foreign-world bastards actually targeted us?!"
"They can’t handle it, and now they’re mad because our District 616 players are stronger!"
"Damn! Too bad I’m too low-level, otherwise rushing in to kill a few foreign players would’ve been worth it!"
"Holy shit, this is outrageous! I also want to class-change to archer, and kill all these foreign-world idiots like Faustus!"
"Archer? Calm down— not every archer is Faustus!"
"I see now. This siege was incited by the trash of District 1213 and 250! They deserve to die!"
And as their view switched to Daniel, their anger instantly turned into fervent admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 -88-Heavy Losses for World District 616
paragraphs: "Did you see that? Did you see that?! Faustus’s arrowstorm! Hundreds, even thousands, gone with a single shot!"
"Epic! Absolutely epic!"
"Has Faustus inherited the legacy of the ancient Arrow God?! He’s invincible!"
"Unbelievable! Every player’s attacks do only -1 damage—his defense is unbreakable! This isn’t an archer, this is a hexagonal warrior!"
[Ding~ The number of surviving players in World District 616 has sharply declined. Combat rating downgraded to SS! Completion rewards increased by 100%!]
Daniel’s lips curved slightly.
Fewer players, same difficulty, and yet the rewards increased.
This meant that if the foreign-world coalition could be subdued, the survivors from District 616 would receive far more than expected.
He glanced at the MC-8848 area; just over ten million players remained fighting.
Enough.
Several Doom Guild members, leading a group of players, quickly approached. At the forefront was Sunborn.
He was drenched in blood, his greatsword still smeared with enemy flesh, yet his eyes burned like flames.
"Guild Leader," he said, bowing respectfully, "the foreign-world players are clearly targeting us."
Daniel nodded slightly.
Being targeted was entirely expected.
If they hadn’t been, it would have been a waste of his reborn advantage.
In fact, it proved that the players of World District 616 had already suppressed the other world districts.
He recalled that the first stage of the Battle of Desperation was Monster Siege.
The monsters would drop points, buffs, and siege equipment needed for the next stage of the event.
Daniel turned to survey the players gathering around him.
"Follow me," he commanded.
He marked the castle’s location on the map, folded it away, and strode forward.
At that moment, a system prompt echoed through the secret realm.
[Secret Realm Announcement: Stage One "Monster Siege" will begin in 60 minutes! Players from all world districts, proceed to your district’s castle and prepare for the siege!]
[Tip: Killing siege monsters grants points, buffs, and siege equipment! Players must take this seriously!]
Buffs...
Daniel’s eyes flashed.
With [Eternal Ring], any temporary buff would become permanent.
This meant that the more monsters he killed during the siege, the stronger he would become.
And those who thought increasing his difficulty was a trap would soon discover that they had instead handed him an incredible gift.
Daniel led hundreds of thousands of players toward the castle.
The wild monsters in the secret realm were as fragile as dried grass before him.
Each drawn arrow felled dozens, and each arrowstorm cleared vast swaths.
The players following him didn’t even need to attack—they simply collected the dropped materials.
It was as if a war god carved a path of slaughter ahead, and behind him marched a group of loot-gathering attendants.
When the towering castle finally came into view, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, as if they had returned from the gates of hell.
Players arrived from all directions, clothes torn and bodies wounded.
Some had HP near zero, unable to use potions due to negative debuffs, and most had damaged or missing equipment.
But when they saw the flag flying atop the castle walls, each exhaled in unison.
Finally.
Daniel stood atop the walls, opening the area panel.
[Current surviving players in World District 616: 188,100,000.]
From over a billion, more than 800 million players had already fallen—and the first stage had only just begun.
The losses were staggering.
Daniel closed the panel, expression impassive, and walked toward the Lord’s Manor.
Within the manor stood a massive stone stele, forged from a dark-golden, unknown metal.
Its surface was etched with intricate runes that emitted a faint glow.
[Lord’s Stele]
The binder gains full control of the castle—operating siege equipment, opening or closing gates, and deploying guards.
If the binder dies, the castle falls.
Daniel placed his right hand on the stele.
"Bind!"
[Ding~ You are attempting to bind the castle. If you die, the castle will fall. Confirm binding?]
"Confirm."
[Ding~ Castle successfully bound. You now possess all control over the castle.]
Daniel withdrew his hand, exhaling slowly.
As long as he survived, World District 616 would not be eliminated by the system.
And with his strength and survival tools... dying would not be easy.
He exited the manor and began organizing defenses in an orderly manner.
"Sunborn, take people to the walls and inspect the siege equipment—trebuchets, ballistae, arrow towers. Activate everything."
"Understood, Guild Leader!"
"Skylight, lead scouts outside the walls to recon the scale and direction of the Monster Siege. Stay safe—avoid unnecessary combat."
"On it!"
"Star Song, set up medical stations inside the castle. All healers, standby."
"Got it!"
"Steel Will, you and your warriors hold the gates. The gates are the first line during the Monster Siege."
"No problem!"
Daniel’s commands flowed like water, each precise and decisive.
He seemed to know every detail of the castle, making optimal decisions without hesitation.
On the walls, trebuchets adjusted angles, ballistae were loaded with massive bolts, and runes atop arrow towers flickered to life.
The gates slowly closed; the heavy iron portcullis dropped with a deafening roar.
In the courtyard, emergency tents had been erected, with potions and bandages neatly arranged.
Warriors checked their weapons and armor, some sharpening blades, some silent, some scanning the horizon.
Everything moved in orderly efficiency.
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
[Have you noticed how familiar Faustus is with this castle?!]
[Yeah... his operations are so fluid, so steady. I wonder, is Faustus a professional strategist in real life?]
[Strategist my foot, it’s Faustus cheating! Give us justice!]
[Hahaha, we found an interesting twist. Faustus won’t be arrogant for long. District 616 will lose this time!]
[I have a bad feeling... these foreign players probably didn’t prepare a thing!]
"Of course. These idiots not only refuse to back down, they even tried to focus-fire us. We’ll remember this grudge!"
[I’m just waiting to see the fun. The siege monsters will give you a big surprise!!]
[Ding~ The number of surviving players in World District 616 has sharply declined. Combat rating downgraded to A! Completion rewards increased by 1000%!]
Daniel didn’t even raise an eyelid.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 -89-5 Billion vs. 100 Million! A High-Stakes Gamble!
paragraphs: [Ding~ The number of surviving players in World District 616 has sharply declined. Combat rating downgraded to A! Completion rewards increased by 1000%!]
Daniel didn’t even raise an eyelid.
As expected, many players from other world districts had likely been slaughtered on a massive scale.
This surge in rewards had been bought with the sacrifice of most of the District 616 players.
Yet for him, this doubling of rewards was more than worth it.
Ten times the completion reward was enough to entice anyone.
He lifted his gaze toward the castle walls.
A system announcement suddenly rang across the secret realm:
[Secret Realm Announcement: Stage One "Monster Siege" is about to commence! Players from all districts, prepare yourselves!]
Daniel strode up to the castle walls, eyes scanning the horizon.
A black dot appeared in the distance.
It quickly stretched into a line... then a massive black wave!
A sea of monsters surged forward, endless and overwhelming.
Towering rock giants, tens of meters tall, stomped heavily, shaking the earth with every step.
Groups of bipedal wyverns blocked out the sky, casting enormous shadows.
Tide-like waves of beastfolk warriors charged with roaring axes, trailed by countless twisted fiends, decaying undead, and blazing demons.
Together, they formed an apocalyptic force, crushing everything in their path.
[Battle Interface]
World District 616 participants: 97,410,000
Combat Rating: A
Monster Count: 5,000,000,000
Monster Rating: SSS
On the castle walls, everyone gasped at the interface.
5 billion monsters!
97 million players!
Almost 50 monsters per player!
And the monsters’ combat rating was two tiers higher than theirs.
"My gods... the number of monsters rivals Earth’s population. This is troublesome!"
A voice trembled.
"Yes... how are we supposed to fight this?"
Brows furrowed, players realized that in both quantity and tier, they were outmatched.
Relying solely on castle defenses and siege equipment would hardly withstand this onslaught.
Worse yet, this was only the first stage of the monsters.
"Damn those foreign-world players! If it weren’t for them, our 1-billion strong district might still have a chance against this Monster Siege!"
Teeth gritted, some muttered angrily.
Daniel ignored all these voices.
He stood atop the walls, slowly raising Stellar Wrath.
A golden arrow condensed on the bowstring.
Memories from past lives surged like a tidal wave. Daniel knew everything about this secret realm.
The number of monsters in the Monster Siege always scaled with the number of defending players—at least tenfold.
What awaited them was an incredibly overwhelming flood of monsters.
More importantly, the secret realm contained a little-known rule:
If leaders of five or more world districts agreed to contribute enough gold coins to the system, they could simultaneously increase both the number and tier of a particular world’s siege monsters.
It was a weapon for the coalition of worlds to suppress a strong district, and the only tool for weaker districts to gang up on stronger ones.
Of course, this required real financial sacrifice.
But Daniel also understood another truth—risk and reward were always proportional.
The more monsters and the higher their tier, the greater the rewards for a successful defense.
The monsters would drop buffs, siege equipment, and anything useful for fortifying the castle.
Simply put: the more they killed, the more they earned.
This was a high-stakes gamble.
The lives of all District 616 players were the wager.
Those foreign-world players’ traps—the gold coin-powered increase in siege difficulty—were, in Daniel’s eyes, just another pile of wealth waiting to be collected.
A cold curve tugged at the corner of his lips.
His mind was already calculating.
[World District 1213 Channel]
The chat was flooding with frenzied, hostile messages:
"This battle, we must erase District 616 from the map!"
"Let them get arrogant! Think they’re impressive because of high player counts? I want to see how long they survive this time!"
"Twelve districts combined, spent gold to double siege numbers and tier... they’re doomed!"
"Ugh... you guys are truly malicious to the bone."
A comment from a District 616 viewer appeared, filled with resentment:
"Even if we didn’t fully understand the external players’ secret messages, we could sense the conspiracy."
In moments, thousands of 616 players flooded Daniel’s viewing channel, messages streaming like a tidal wave:
"Brothers, the truth is out! These monsters were manipulated by the foreign districts!"
"Exactly, we’ve confirmed it—they tampered with our district’s siege monsters!"
"Damn! These foreign bastards have no bottom line!"
"Is this info reliable? Can the game even allow this?"
"Damn! Our chat alerts don’t even reach the secret realm!"
"They trapped us once during teleport... and now again! Too much!"
"Don’t panic, everyone, don’t panic. We have Faustus!"
"Yes, with Faustus, what’s there to fear?"
Gradually, panic subsided, replaced by silent, unwavering trust.
Everyone understood: they had a superpowered champion on their side.
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The chat exploded:
"This is insane!"
"I just checked the foreign-world spectator channels. They’re facing only 30 million siege monsters, rating A..."
"No doubt, those foreign bastards are messing with the numbers!"
"District 616 is in real danger this time!"
"Hahaha, those cheaters are stunned now—enjoy it!"
"So what if they have Faustus? Can he really take down 5 billion monsters alone?"
"A bunch of jealous fools, don’t get cocky."
"Wait... look, Faustus is moving!"
Daniel’s eyes scanned the approaching ocean of monsters.
Ten kilometers... three kilometers... one kilometer...
"Fire!"
Sunborn’s roar echoed across the walls.
Hundreds of ballistae fired simultaneously, thick bolts carving bloody lanes through the monster waves.
Trebuchets hurled massive stones, smashing through crowds of monsters, splattering flesh and bone.
Runes atop arrow towers flared, unleashing a torrential downpour of magical arrows.
Yet against a sea of 5 billion monsters, these attacks were mere drops in the ocean.
The monsters roared and surged forward, stepping over fallen allies without pause.
Their numbers were so immense, it was almost hopeless.
At that moment, Daniel leapt from the walls.
Black Dragon Wings unfurled behind him, spanning over ten meters.
He hovered in the air, high above, gazing down upon the boundless sea of monsters.
