chapters.title: Chapter 90 -90-Slaying Monsters Like Dogs
paragraphs: Under the gaze of millions, Daniel raised his Stellar Wrath!
Arrows of Nature coalesced on the bowstring.
Arrowstorm!
Shattering Comet!
Two skills were unleashed simultaneously.
A single golden arrow shot straight into the clouds, exploding at its apex into thousands of shards of light.
At the same time, countless arrows rained down from the sky, intertwining and merging with the radiant fragments.
For a moment, the entire heavens were filled with golden light.
The shards plummeted with blazing tails, crashing down upon everything below.
BOOM—BOOM—BOOM—!
Golden fire engulfed all.
The ground trembled, the sky roared.
The explosions merged into a deafening symphony, shockwaves overturning every monster within hundreds of meters.
Rock giants shattered into pieces, bipedal wyverns were reduced to ashes, and beastfolk warriors vanished before even letting out a scream.
A massive crater hundreds of meters wide appeared on the ground, its walls still burning with golden flames!
[Ding! You have slain 9,454 monsters!]
[Dungeon Points +35,000!]
[Eternal Ring triggered! Temporary buff gained: Strength increase → PERMANENT!]
Daniel blinked slightly, then a faint smile spread across his lips.
These five billion monsters weren’t a catastrophe—they were treasures from his private collection!
"Roar! Roar! Roar!"
At the same time, a deafening roar echoed from the void.
The Earthmount Dragon emerged from the clouds, its fifty-meter-long massive body blocking half the sky.
Its body, composed of rock and ancient wood, glimmered with amber on every scale. A row of sharp stone spines ran down its back like an inverted mountain ridge.
The instant it spread its wings, the air itself quaked.
It opened its massive jaws, releasing a torrent of crystal-blue dragon breath.
Countless tiny blue crystals, each sharp as a blade, rained down with Strength enough to rip through the earth.
The crystal rain struck the monster horde. The ground split instantly, and clusters of crystals shot up from beneath, impaling monsters midair.
At this moment, the dragon was a living calamity, the wrath of the earth, Daniel’s sharpest fang!
Wherever the crystal clusters passed, monsters’ HP jumped by the millions—row after row collapsed.
The Earthmount Dragon let out an earth-shattering roar, beating its wings as it plunged into the deepest part of the horde.
Its undying nature made it a blade that could never break, freely harvesting life from its enemies!
Daniel watched the little stone dragon slaughter with satisfaction.
It was its first time enjoying such a carnage.
The last time at the dwarven Ironforge, to prevent excessive losses, he had personally annihilated the fortress’s elite forces.
This had left most players and NPCs little room to act.
"Continue!"
Daniel drew his bow again.
Void Arrow!
A golden arrow infused with elemental energy streaked through the horde.
Where it passed, the ground was carved into charred trenches, monsters on either side shredded by elemental force.
Aetherlance!
A golden spear tore through the air, piercing three epic-grade rock giants and exploding deep within the horde, clearing a vast area.
Arrowstorm!
Countless explosive arrows poured down like a storm. Each hit triggered an explosion, causing chain reactions that devoured all nearby monsters.
Alone, Daniel stood in the center of the monster sea with his bow, utterly unrestrained.
Beneath him flowed a violent, ocean-like tide of beasts.
His arrows never stopped, golden light flashing frenetically around him.
Every draw of his bow felled thousands.
Every release cleared a massive area!
The monsters surged toward him, yet none could breach the three-hundred-meter radius around him.
Within this zone, a crimson death zone was forcibly carved out.
Any monster stepping inside would be shredded by a storm of arrows!
[Ding! You have slain 100,000 monsters!]
[Ding! You have slain 1,000,000 monsters!]
[Ding! You have slain 10,000,000 monsters!]
[Permanent buff gained: Strength increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Constitution increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Agility increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Skill Replication (legendary-grade)!]
The system alerts scrolled so fast Daniel barely glanced at them.
Only one buff caught his attention:
Skill Replication (legendary-grade)
Effect: When using a skill, an additional copy of the same skill is cast automatically.
With the Eternal Ring, this effect was now permanent!
A glint shone in Daniel’s eyes as he drew again.
Aetherlance!
Whoosh—!
A golden spear tore through the air.
Then a second golden spear materialized, following immediately!
Two arrows!
One shot fired two arrows!
BOOM—BOOM—!
The twin spears carved a death lane through the monster tide, endless as far as the eye could see!
Double damage!
A cold, sharp arc curved on Daniel’s lips.
He continued the harvest.
The monster tide surged, then collapsed like waves.
In just ten minutes, countless corpses piled up around him.
The bodies formed small hills, which then piled atop each other into even taller mountains.
Daniel stood atop this mountain of corpses, looking down like a reaper harvesting life itself!
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The chat had completely erupted.
[The gods are above... The gods are above... THE GODS ARE ABOVE!!!]
[What am I seeing? One man with a bow just killed tens of millions of monsters?!]
[Is this a game? Is this a movie? This is insane!]
[Oh, thanks! Faustus is such a broken archer! Cheating blatantly, destroying the game environment!]
[F*ck! You idiots in the other-world servers just sit there helplessly, fuming in vain, haha!]
[Wait... do you notice? Faustus is glowing more and more! Every time he kills a batch of monsters, another light appears! These buffs are stacking him into a monster himself!]
[This doesn’t make sense! The longer the monsters siege, the stronger Faustus gets? So if we pay for more difficulty, we’re just giving him free power-ups... idiots!]
[Servers 1213 and 250, thanks for the 5 billion monster gift pack! Faustus graciously accepts!]
[Player tips Faustus 1,000 gold coins! Message: Great Faustus, fight through with our will!]
[Player tips Faustus 5,000 gold coins! Message: Show those other-world servers what true Strength is!]

You have slain 1,000,000 monsters!]
[Ding!
You have slain 10,000,000 monsters!]
[Permanent buff gained: Strength increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Constitution increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Agility increase (legendary-grade)!]
[Permanent buff gained: Skill Replication (legendary-grade)!]
The system alerts scrolled so fast Daniel barely glanced at them.
Only one buff caught his attention:
Skill Replication (legendary-grade)
Effect: When using a skill, an additional copy of the same skill is cast automatically.
With the Eternal Ring, this effect was now permanent!
A glint shone in Daniel’s eyes as he drew again.
Aetherlance!
Whoosh—!
A golden spear tore through the air.
Then a second golden spear materialized, following immediately!
Two arrows!
One shot fired two arrows!
BOOM—BOOM—!
The twin spears carved a death lane through the monster tide, endless as far as the eye could see!
Double damage!
A cold, sharp arc curved on Daniel’s lips.
He continued the harvest.
The monster tide surged, then collapsed like waves.
In just ten minutes, countless corpses piled up around him.
The bodies formed small hills, which then piled atop each other into even taller mountains.
Daniel stood atop this mountain of corpses, looking down like a reaper harvesting life itself!
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
The chat had completely erupted.
[The gods are above...
The gods are above...
THE GODS ARE ABOVE!!!]
[What am I seeing?
One man with a bow just killed tens of millions of monsters?!]
[Is this a game?
Is this a movie?
This is insane!]
[Oh, thanks!
Faustus is such a broken archer!
Cheating blatantly, destroying the game environment!]
[F*ck!
You idiots in the other-world servers just sit there helplessly, fuming in vain, haha!]
[Wait... do you notice?
Faustus is glowing more and more!
Every time he kills a batch of monsters, another light appears!
These buffs are stacking him into a monster himself!]
[This doesn’t make sense!
The longer the monsters siege, the stronger Faustus gets?
So if we pay for more difficulty, we’re just giving him free power-ups... idiots!]
[Servers 1213 and 250, thanks for the 5 billion monster gift pack!
Faustus graciously accepts!]
[Player tips Faustus 1,000 gold coins!
Message: Great Faustus, fight through with our will!]
[Player tips Faustus 5,000 gold coins!
Message: Show those other-world servers what true Strength is!]

chapters.title: Chapter 91 -91-The Alliance Strangles Faustus
paragraphs: On the city walls, the players of World Server 616 were utterly dumbfounded.
They had expected a grueling, desperate siege.
They were prepared to fight to the death.
Even if they died, it would be glorious—they would not let the other-world server bastards laugh at them!
But the scene before them made all their preparations feel completely unnecessary.
A monster horde invasion?
No, no, no—this was clearly Faustus alone, slaughtering five billion monsters!
And growing stronger with every kill.
"I... am I dreaming?"
A warrior muttered.
"If you’re dreaming, so am I."
The mage next to him looked equally dazed.
"Are we... dreaming the same dream?"
"Stop talking!"
Sunborn bellowed, "What are you standing there for?"
"Faustus-sama is killing up ahead! We can’t slack behind—those are free dungeon points waiting for us!"
"Right! Kill monsters, grab points!"
"Charge, brothers!"
Thousands of players poured off the city walls, crazily diving into the horde to mop up the monsters Faustus had missed.
The scene looked like a pack of lion cubs following a lion king: the king hunted, and the cubs ate the meat.
[Global Live Stream · Faustus Channel]
[Hahaha, this is killing me! World Server 616 can clear this while lying down!]
[Faustus-sama kills upfront, they clean up behind him—perfect coordination!]
[Thanks, other-world server guys, for the free gift!]
Meanwhile, World Server 1213 was deathly silent.
Utter silence.
After a long while, someone shakily typed:
"Did... we do something wrong?"
No one answered.
They all knew the answer.
They had done wrong—they should never have gifted Faustus five billion monsters!
Daniel’s assault hardly paused for a moment.
Every arrow he loosed became a torrent, sweeping away countless monsters’ lives.
[Ding! Permanent buff gained: Skill Replication (legendary-grade)!]
[Notice: Your buff stack has reached the dungeon maximum (40 stacks). Increase your character level to unlock higher limits.]
The system alert sounded constantly in his ears, but he had no time to care.
With Skill Replication, each arrow effectively shot fifty identical attacks at once!
A single Aetherlance meant ninety golden streaks tore through the air, trailing scorching tails into the horde.
Area-of-effect skills were even more terrifying.
Arrowstorm and Shattering Comet were already hundred-meter-range skills, but with fiftyfold replication, they intertwined into a domain of death comparable to a forbidden curse!
Wherever the arrows passed, monsters could not even leave ash behind.
If the system did not restrict his firing speed, Daniel could likely annihilate all five billion monsters in no time.
But on second thought, the restriction hardly mattered.
After all, no matter the enemy, a single Aetherlance could end everything.
Once he reached level 150, he could study the true forbidden art, Skyfall Cataclysm!
With Stellar Wrath in hand, each skill’s power would double—making forbidden skill damage unimaginable.
And as Stellar Wrath grew, these numbers would continue to climb.
Half a day passed. Daniel looked up, and the once ocean-like flood of monsters had been partially slaughtered—over one billion down.
Yet the remaining monsters still surged toward the city walls.
Flying beasts’ wings blocked the sky, hovering above the fortress, intercepting arrows and spells.
Melee players on the walls could only helplessly look up at their airborne enemies.
Their blades could not reach the sky, and shields could barely withstand diving attacks.
The siege monsters’ rank far exceeded ordinary wild monsters.
Without Daniel holding the line, the remaining players alone could never have defended the city against the tide of five billion monsters.
[World Server 250 · Main City]
The commander of World Server 250, Johnson, sat atop a silver-white unicorn, inspecting the perfectly arrayed legion before him.
On the distant horizon, heaps of siege monster corpses formed mountains, and the air was thick with the scent of blood.
"Besides World Server 616, the other servers’ castle defenses should all be completed."
Johnson asked his adjutant quietly.
"Correct. I hear only World Server 616 is still fighting desperately."
The adjutant replied calmly.
A satisfied smile crept across Johnson’s face.
The five major servers had pooled resources, drastically increasing the siege difficulty for World Server 616.
No matter how godlike the monster called Faustus was, the players of World Server 616 would surely suffer severe losses this time.
"Such an opportunity cannot be missed," he murmured, a cold gleam in his eyes.
"If we can seize this chance to capture their castle and eliminate them completely..."
He straightened, facing the ready legion, his voice echoing across the field:
"Warriors! Glory belongs to us! Crush World Server 616 under our feet!"
Behind him, tens of millions of players shouted in unison:
"Glory belongs to us! Crush World Server 616!"
"Freedom and honor together!"
Meanwhile, World Servers 1213, 82, 840, 38, and 700—six major servers in total—marched simultaneously toward World Server 616’s castle.
A grand army of 500 million players!
Their only goal: to wipe the castle completely off the map.
The next day, World Server 616 Castle.
[Ding! Item obtained: Teleportation Scroll (Rare) ×1!]
[Ding! Item obtained: Teleportation Scroll (Rare) ×1!]
Daniel’s bow never paused, turning the last stubborn monsters to ash.
Aetherlance!
Fifty golden streaks tore through the air, impaling the remaining monsters onto the scorched earth.
No large monster clusters remained; only scattered stragglers struggled under the walls, soon eliminated by defending players.
Daniel exhaled slowly.
"The first stage of the dungeon... finally over."
For others, this battle was intense; for him, it was a rebirth.
Permanent buffs stacked layer by layer, exponentially increasing his strength.
Now, each attack dealt over four million damage, just shy of the five million threshold.
He opened his backpack, eyes falling on a few archaic-looking scrolls:
[Teleportation Scroll (Rare)]
Restriction: Only usable in the dungeon
Effect: Teleports the user to any castle in any world server
Description: A special item for the Battle of Desperation event; it disintegrates if removed from this dungeon
Daniel traced the runes on the scroll’s edge, a cold glint in his eyes.
Perfect timing—this was exactly what he needed.
One scroll meant one chance to descend straight into the enemy’s lair.
And what would happen after arrival...

chapters.title: Chapter 92 -92-Striking at the Enemy’s Home Base
paragraphs: At the thought, the corners of Daniel’s lips curled upward slightly, though there was not a trace of warmth in that smile.
Just then, the system notification arrived right on cue.
[Ding! Congratulations to World Server 616 for completing the first-stage mission! All surviving players receive an SSS-grade reward: gold-grade Exp Card ×100,000!]

[Ding! Congratulations to player "Faustus" for successfully leading World Server 616 in repelling the monster siege! Personal contribution: 96%! Special bonus reward granted: epic-grade Exp Card ×10,000!]
At the same time, the five-hundred-million-strong allied army from the six world servers was gathering a hundred miles away.
[Dungeon Announcement: The first-stage mission has fully concluded. The second stage, "Endless Warfire," has now begun!]
[Notice: All world servers, protect your own castle and the safety of the player bound to it. If the castle falls or the bound player dies, that world server will be eliminated.]
[Notice: Once a castle falls, the bound player’s coordinates will be marked on the map!]
After hearing the announcement, the commanders of the six world servers exchanged a knowing look.
World Server 616 might have survived the monster siege, but by now they had to be exhausted, a spent arrow at the end of its flight.
"No need for tactics. Just charge straight into World Server 616 and crush them!"
"Can’t be helped. Most of the players in World Server 616 are basically cheating anyway. We have to eliminate them first, or the rest of our servers won’t stand a chance later!"
"Against World Server 616, let the players of World Server 1213 take the lead!"
"Count in World Server 82 too. I’ve been sick of them for ages!"
On the World Channel, the clamor and provocation from the other servers rose one after another.
Daniel glanced at the Teleportation Scroll in his backpack and slowly crushed it.
[Notice: You have used "Teleportation Scroll (Rare)." Please select a target castle for teleportation.]
"World Server 1213."
[Teleportation initiated!]
The next instant, white light swallowed everything.
When Daniel’s figure solidified again, he was already standing inside a completely unfamiliar castle.
[Notice: You have successfully descended upon the defensive castle of World Server 1213.]
He swept his gaze around. The streets were empty, and the defenses lax.
It was obvious that the players of World Server 1213 had sent nearly all their main forces to the battlefield of World Server 616.
A few of the players left behind were the first to notice this uninvited intruder. They froze for a moment, then their expressions turned vicious.
"Huh? A player from World Server 616?!"
"That’s strange. How did he get in here?"
"Who cares? This guy’s probably some scout from World Server 616. Enough talk—kill him!"
They drew their weapons and surged toward Daniel.
Daniel let out a cold laugh.
Shattering Comet!
Aetherlance!
Arrowstorm!
Three powerful skills erupted at once.
Countless arrows wove together into a net of death, covering a full tenth of the castle!
Crimson damage numbers poured down like a waterfall. Players of World Server 1213 fell in waves, dissolving into white light.
After only two volleys, not a single living enemy remained anywhere in the castle.
And when those slain World Server 1213 players awoke at the respawn point, what awaited them was a reality even crueler than death...
Level -5. Core equipment lost. Backpack completely emptied.
And on top of that, an astronomical debt.
"Wait, what happened? What the hell happened to my account? Isn’t this completely ruined now...?"
"This is ridiculous! I’m reporting Faustus for cheating!"
"I got killed, lost all my core gear, and now I owe Faustus several million gold coins? What kind of hellish joke is this?!"
"I’m so mad I’m laughing. Wasn’t the saying that ants can bite an elephant to death? That guy on the other side isn’t even a living creature!"
"What even just happened? Why did I suddenly die? I spent a whole month grinding this gear and these levels!"
Their anger and confusion filled the air, yet no one could answer them.
Daniel stepped over the wreckage and walked straight toward the depths of the Lord’s Manor.
The dark-gold stone monument stood quietly at the center of the hall, runes flowing across its surface and casting a dim glow.
Without hesitation, he raised Stellar Wrath and fired an Aetherlance at it!
Arrowstorm!
Shattering Comet!
A rain of arrows poured down onto the monument, and damage numbers exploded wildly across its surface.
After only three attacks, the monument was already covered in spiderweb-like cracks.
Then the fourth Aetherlance slammed into it.
The castle monument shattered with a thunderous crash, exploding into fragments across the floor.
[Notice: You have destroyed the castle monument of World Server 1213! Reward obtained: Flight Mastery Fragment (supreme-grade) ×1!]
[Notice: The castle of World Server 1213 has fallen! The coordinates of the bound player have been marked on the map!]
[Ding! Millionfold Boost triggered! Obtained: Flight Mastery Fragment (supreme-grade) ×1!]
At the same time, the dungeon announcement rang through the minds of every player.
[Ding! World Server 1213 has been eliminated!]
Far away on the battlefield of World Server 616, the players of World Server 1213 heard the announcement and their minds went blank.
"What happened? Our home... got raided?!"
"Can someone tell me how the enemy got into our castle?!"
"Their castle defense battle only just ended—how did Faustus suddenly appear inside World Server 1213’s castle?!"
"Shit, that cheating bastard! He must be hacking! Damn it!!"
"To all players of Stellar, let us unite in protest against Faustus’s cheating behavior! Let us stand together against this hacking dog—"
The players of World Server 1213 were left utterly lost and bewildered.
Meanwhile, Daniel did not remain idle. He had already crushed the second Teleportation Scroll.
The strange movements of World Server 1213 soon alerted the commanders of the other allied servers.
"Mr. Zorro, your condition doesn’t seem quite right?"
"What happened?"
The commander of World Server 250, Thomson, spoke with a hint of probing in his tone.
Zorro’s face was pale as paper, and his voice trembled uncontrollably.
"Lord Thomson... our castle has been taken by Faustus."
At those words, a sharp gleam flashed through Thomson’s eyes.
How was that possible?
Faustus wasn’t in the castle of World Server 616?
He knew exactly what that implied.
Unlike Zorro, who was furious and horrified, Thomson was filled with delight.
Without Faustus’s protection, the castle before them was nothing more than a lamb waiting for slaughter.
If they could seize this chance and take it in one stroke...
But just as the corners of his mouth began to lift, a cold system notification cut through his fantasy like a blade.
[Ding-dong! Attention, all players of World Server 250: Player "Faustus" of World Server 616 is attacking this server’s castle monument...]
"What?!"
The smile on Thomson’s face froze instantly.
Wasn’t Faustus in World Server 1213?
How could he possibly... how had he done it?!
"Damn that Faustus! Despicable coward!"
Thomson’s roar exploded through the channel, shocking his subordinates into silence.
Yet the nightmare was far from over.

One system notification after another rang out like funeral bells.
The six commanders looked at one another, their faces ashen.
"Everyone, at this point, there’s no saving the situation!"
Someone clenched his teeth and said, "Since Faustus isn’t there, we might as well gather all our Strength and take down World Server 616’s castle in one push!"
"Exactly! If World Server 616 falls too, we’ll all be back on the same starting line!"
"That cheating dog Faustus has gone too far! We have to let him have a taste of what it feels like to get his home base raided too!"
At once, the five-hundred-million-strong army surged madly toward World Server 616’s castle.
Faced with this torrent, the defenders of World Server 616 were forced into continuous retreat, their numbers dropping sharply.
[Ding-dong~ The number of players in World Server 616 has sharply declined. Current strength evaluation: B-rank! Stage-clear reward increased to 10000%!]
Hearing the prompt, Daniel arched a brow.
He immediately crushed the last Teleportation Scroll and rushed back toward World Server 616’s castle.
On the battlefield, a warrior from World Server 616 blinked behind a player from World Server 1213 and brought his greatsword down with vicious force.
-54,640! Critical Hit!
The player from World Server 1213 had his HP instantly reduced to a sliver.
"Just a little more! Damn it!"
Unwillingness flashed through the eyes of the World Server 616 warrior.
The player from World Server 1213 was still shaken, secretly thanking his luck that he had obtained several defensive buffs during the castle defense.
If not for that, he would already have been eliminated.
But his relief quickly turned into terror.
Without warning, countless arrows descended from the sky, engulfing him and the companions around him at the same time.
The player from World Server 1213 did not even have time to let out a scream before he was burned to ashes.
At the respawn point, four system notifications echoed in his ears like the whispers of a demon.
[You were killed by player "Faustus" of World Server 616. Debt effect triggered. Current debt: 220,000 gold coin!]
[You were killed by player "Faustus" of World Server 616. Death Curse triggered. Current level -5!]
[You were killed by player "Faustus" of World Server 616. Death Curse triggered. 6 pieces of equipment forcibly dropped!]
[You were killed by player "Faustus" of World Server 616. Death Curse triggered. All backpack materials and items forcibly dropped!]
"WTF?!"
He collapsed onto the ground, dazed.
Could this game still even be played?
Losing five levels was one thing... but what kind of logic was this debt mechanic?
And why the hell had all his core equipment dropped too?
Countless players from World Server 1213 fell into the same shock and regret.
At that moment, waves of alarmed cries erupted across the battlefield.
"Faustus! It’s Guildmaster Faustus!"
"Oh, Lord above, is Faustus a devil?"
"Wasn’t he just at our castle? How did he return in an instant?! How is that even possible?!"
"Focus fire! Everyone, focus fire! If each of our hundreds of millions of players lands one hit, that’s still hundreds of millions of damage! I refuse to believe he can tank it!!"
The moment Daniel appeared at the center of the battlefield, the already despairing allied forces from the outer servers completely lost their minds.
Countless skills, arrows, and spells poured toward that silver-white figure like a violent storm, blotting out the sky.
Yet Daniel did not even bother to dodge.
Stellar Wrath formed a translucent barrier around him, and the attacks—powerful enough to tear through city walls—did nothing more than send small ripples spreading across its surface.
His gaze remained calm as still water, as though the vast army before him were no more than a passing breeze.
And by now, the spectator channel had completely exploded.
The barrage from countless World Server 616 players overflowed with feverish excitement.
[Lord Faustus, show them what true slaughter looks like!]
[Lord Faustus is too merciful—he actually still gave them a chance to attack!?]
[Hahahaha... these idiots really didn’t use their brains at all. Did they seriously not think about how those five billion monsters got wiped out in just two days?]
[Lord Faustus, turn those foolish players from the other worlds into ashes!]
The fierce discussion flooded the screen like madness.
Within the dungeon, Daniel slowly raised Stellar Wrath.
A pale golden halo spread outward from his body, cleansing all negative statuses.
Arrowstorm!
A tide of black arrows swept downward, covering several hundred meters straight ahead.
The outer-server players caught in the arrow rain did not even have time to scream before dissolving into white light.
Shattering Comet!
Countless arrows fell from the clouds, pinning vast swathes of enemies onto the scorched earth.
Aetherlance!
Fifty golden streaks of light ripped through the air, trailing blazing tails as they pierced through the crowd!
Where they passed, they left behind only massive, charred trenches.
As far as the eye could see, dense crimson damage numbers stretched like a blood-red galaxy, staining the entire sky red.
With every wave of arrows that fell, hundreds of thousands of players dissolved into white light.
Those white lights fell so densely they became a tragic sea of radiance across the battlefield.
Daniel stood amidst mountains of corpses and rivers of blood, firing arrow after arrow, wave after wave pouring forth like a tide.
His MP seemed endless.
His stamina seemed inexhaustible.
The scene was like a god passing judgment upon all living beings.
[Dungeon Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Server 616 has killed more than twenty million players! Dungeon achievement obtained: "Bloody Judge"!]
The cold synthesized electronic voice fell into the ears of every player from the outer servers like the sentence of death itself.
One skill, and hundreds of thousands were annihilated.
That scene was simply... too horrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 -94-Exclusive Reward — Water Elemental Core
paragraphs: "No, seriously, are we sure this game is called Stellar... and not Faustus’s Playground?!"
"Fuck! What are you idiots still standing around for?! Run!"
A cold glint flashed through Daniel’s eyes as starlight shimmered across Stellar Wrath.
Shattering Comet!
Arrowstorm!
Aetherlance!
Wherever the arrows swept through, entire swaths of players were erased, leaving nearly a third of the crowd gone in an instant.
[Dungeon Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Region No. 616 has killed over 100 million players! Obtained the dungeon achievement "Reaper’s Scythe"!]
The spectator channel exploded.
[So this... this is the ultimate form of a top-tier player?!]
[What the hell? One skill into a crowd and it gets wiped clean? Is this guy playing some kind of match-three game?!]
[Invincible. At this moment, that word has literally taken form!]
Time passed amid endless slaughter.
Several hours slipped by in the blink of an eye.
When the final flash of light faded, not a single enemy remained standing on the battlefield.
[Dungeon Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Region No. 616 has killed over 400 million players! Obtained the dungeon achievement "Hell Tyrant"!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 1213 has been eliminated!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 250 has been eliminated!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 82 has been eliminated!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 700 has been eliminated!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 38 has been eliminated!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 840 has been eliminated!]
The elimination notices rang out one after another, until at last, silence returned.
Aside from World Region No. 616, all players from the six strongest foreign world regions had been completely wiped out.
"Holy shit! We... we won?"
One player from World Region No. 616 muttered in disbelief.
"It’s hard to believe, but yeah... we really did win."
Someone clenched their fists so tightly their knuckles turned white.
"Thank God for Faustus... thank God for him!"
[Dungeon Announcement: Phase Two — "Endless Warfare" has ended. World Region No. 616 has successfully cleared the stage!]
[Dungeon Announcement: World Region No. 616’s clearance rewards have been increased by 10,000%! All players of World Region No. 616 receive: Contribution Points +10,000, Gold Coins +10,000!]
[Dungeon Announcement: Player "Faustus" contributed 99%! Obtained special rewards: Flight Mastery Fragment (epic-grade) ×1, hidden dungeon exchange interface, Points +100,000!]
[Dungeon Announcement: The dungeon event "Battle of Desperation" will close in 30 minutes. All players, please exchange your points as soon as possible and leave in an orderly manner.]
A flood of system prompts rang out by Daniel’s ear one after another.
[Ding! Obtained Flight Mastery Fragment (supreme-grade) ×1, Points +3.8 billion!]
He opened his inventory. Seven Arcana Fragments lay neatly lined up inside, each emitting a faint glow.
[Flight Mastery Fragment (supreme-grade) ×7]
Can be synthesized!
His gaze sharpened, then shifted to that special reward.
[Hidden Dungeon Exchange Interface (Unique)]
In all his previous lives, he had never once heard of such a reward.
A sharp light flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
This was most likely a reward that could only be unlocked by fulfilling some extremely specific trigger condition.
And his heaven-defying performance in this event had clearly satisfied every last requirement.
Daniel first took out one of the pale golden fragments from his bag and examined it carefully in his palm.
The fragment was roughly the size of a hand. Its surface was carved with intricate rune patterns, and faint starlight flowed along its edges.
[Flight Mastery Fragment (supreme-grade)]
Type: Synthesis Material
Synthesis Requirement: legendary-grade Engineer

Description: A fragment containing ancient flight arcana. Gather all seven to synthesize a complete Flight Arcana Core. Once fused with a wing apparatus of legendary-grade or above, it will grant a transcendent power of flight beyond mortal limits.
After reading its description, Daniel’s lips curved slightly upward.
His secondary class just so happened to be legendary-grade Engineer, so once he returned to Polaris City, he could begin the synthesis process immediately.
But for now, there was something even more important to do. Before the dungeon closed, he had to exchange the points in his possession for the most valuable items possible.
"Dungeon exchange..."
He murmured softly and raised his hand to open the exchange interface.
Whoosh—
Two translucent panels unfolded before his eyes at the same time.
The one on the left was the normal exchange panel. On the right was a line of pale golden text.
[Hidden Dungeon Exchange · Exclusive to Faustus]
The normal exchange was no different from what he remembered from his previous life.
But the items in the hidden exchange interface...
Every single one of them was at least gold-grade or higher, and each could only be exchanged once. Moreover, every exchanged item was bound.
Of course, the point cost for the hidden exchange items was equally outrageous.
Daniel glanced at his total points.
[Current Dungeon Points: 13 billion!]
That amount of points was enough to leave any player dumbfounded.
But Daniel knew that in the hidden exchange interface, even that enormous sum might not last long.
His eyes moved to the hidden exchange panel.
[Hidden Dungeon Exchange]
[Special Items] [Potions] [Equipment] [Weapons] [Pets] [Skill Books]
Daniel opened each category one by one, his gaze swiftly sweeping across the dazzling assortment of items.
Then his eyes suddenly locked onto one particular item and could no longer move away.
[Water Elemental Core]
Grade: supreme-grade
Exchange Requirement: 5 billion points
Description: A core containing the source strength of the water element, a crystallization of the Elemental Plane’s origin. Only beings at the level of an Elemental Lord are capable of condensing it.
Daniel barely hesitated before clicking exchange immediately.
Only after that crystal, radiating a deep blue glow, dropped into his palm did he let out a long breath.
In his previous lives, countless players had shared a single dream—
to gather all seven Elemental Cores and unlock the legendary [Chronoverse Prologue Codex].
Time Reversal, Spatial Lock, Spacetime Collapse...
Those spacetime skills, powerful enough to rewrite the course of a battle, were the lifelong pursuit of every player.
And now, he had already taken the first step.
[Ding! You have spent 5 billion points and obtained [Water Elemental Core (supreme-grade)]!]
Daniel carefully stored the Elemental Core in his bag, then continued browsing the exchange list.
After obtaining the Water Elemental Core, he still had more than 7 billion points left.
It did not take long before his attention was drawn to a certain skill book.
[Prompt: Do you wish to spend 1 billion points to exchange for the skill book "Serpent’s Thundercell (legendary-grade)" ?]
"Yes!"
Daniel’s pupils contracted sharply. The current version’s skill cap was only SSS-grade, yet this skill had actually surpassed the version limit!
As expected of a reward from an exchange interface with such absurdly difficult trigger conditions—the threshold was high, but its value was just as astonishing.
Daniel did not hesitate in the slightest.
[Ding! Obtained skill book "Serpent’s Thundercell (legendary-grade)"!]

chapters.title: Chapter 95 -95-A Supreme-Grade Equipment — Hellfang!
paragraphs: He opened the skill book crackling with violet lightning.
[Serpent’s Thundercell (legendary-grade)]
Type: Archer Active Skill

Effect: Draws upon the power of lightning in the sky to create a thunderstorm domain over a designated area (range: 1000 × 1000 meters). All enemy targets within the domain are forcibly afflicted with the following debuffs: [Paralysis], [Silence], and [Slow].
Within the domain, 100,000 lightning-serpent arrows are automatically generated, continuously attacking all enemies in range. Each arrow deals damage equal to 100% of the caster’s Attack Power.
The duration of the thunderstorm domain is controlled by the caster (consumes 1% MP per second and may be terminated at any time).

Description: A divine skill created by the ancient God of Archers after comprehending the Law of Thunder. One arrow summons heavenly lightning; ten thousand arrows descend like a raging tempest. Those trapped by this arrow can only stand there and await Thunder Verdict.
A smile curved Daniel’s lips.
With a large-scale archer skill like this, combined with all of his stacked buffs, a single rain of arrows would be enough to cover an entire city.
By then, destroying a city with one arrow would be no joke at all.
Only a legendary-grade skill of this level was worthy of his current strength.
"Learn!"
[Prompt: You have learned the skill "Serpent’s Thundercell (legendary-grade)"!]
"This skill is absolutely worth far more than 1 billion points in the current version! I really hit the jackpot this time!"
No wonder everything in this special exchange interface was forcibly bound. After all, any item capable of surpassing the current version’s limits was blatantly overpowered.
Daniel closed the skill panel and continued browsing the hidden exchange interface.
Before long, he spent another 3 billion points to exchange for an epic-grade item.
[Ding! Consumed 3 billion points. Obtained special item "Banner of Valor (legendary-grade)"!]
Daniel took the banner out of his inventory.
It was a silver-white war banner, embroidered with a brilliant star across the fabric, with golden tassels lining the edges.
The moment he held it, a heavy sense of duty surged from the bottom of his heart.
[Banner of Valor (legendary-grade)]
Type: Special Item (Bound)
Effects:

When equipped, it can collect the lingering souls of powerful members of your race (default: Human). The lingering souls of legendary-grade experts can be transformed into tangible relics, with the relic type determined by the obsession they held in life. Each soul collected requires 1 trillion gold coins, and each soul transformed also requires 1 trillion gold coins.
Description: From the moment you take up this banner, you become the backbone of your race. Its survival or destruction, its prosperity or decline, shall be decided by you.
After reading the description, Daniel solemnly equipped the war banner.
With this item, if a Human Watcher fell in battle in the future, he would no longer need to scour the world for their remains.
He could simply use the Banner of Valor to transform the soul into a relic, then revive them with [Seraphic Revival].
"In the versions to come, every battle will be an apocalyptic disaster... With this, humanity’s fate may not be as tragic as it was in my previous lives."
Those 3 billion points had been more than worth it.
He glanced at his remaining points—there were still over 3 billion left!
"I thought having over 10 billion points was a lot..."
Daniel shook his head with a bitter smile and turned his gaze toward the potion tab.
[Plunderer (epic-grade)]
Exchange Requirement: 100 million points
Daniel possessed the [Eternal Ring] talent, which allowed any potion to be converted into a permanent effect.
Naturally, there was no way he would let such a top-tier potion—something impossible to buy outside—slip through his fingers.
"Exchange."
[Ding! Consumed 100 million points. Obtained "Plunderer (legendary-grade potion)"!]
[Plunderer (legendary-grade)]
Effect: After killing a target, automatically obtains all items on the target’s body (no looting required; everything is automatically added to your inventory).
A sharp gleam flashed through Daniel’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 96 -96-Flight Arcana, Eternal Black King!
paragraphs: A burning light flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
A top-tier legion like that was naturally something the more he had, the better.
He immediately swept through the hidden exchange interface, buying out every kind of Class Awakening Scroll for military units across various grades, spending a total of 1 billion points.
Now that he already had the Special Unit Class Awakening Scrolls, the only things left were population and legion warriors.
Thinking of the world-ending calamities he would face in the future—enemies numbering in the tens of billions at every turn—
the mere few million NPC troops under his command were nothing more than a drop in the ocean.
Daniel shifted his gaze to the normal exchange interface.
He spent 500 million points to recruit 50 million legion warriors of various unit types.
[Ding! Consumed 500 million points. Obtained gold-grade warriors of all troop types ×50,000,000!]
[Prompt: Please designate a city on the map. The legion warriors will arrive in that city in 30 minutes.]
"Ironforge."
Daniel selected the location.
After settling the legion warriors, he turned his attention to NPC population.
With 100 million points, he exchanged for 100 million NPC civilians, assigning them to Ironforge and Polaris City respectively.
Ironforge’s capacity was limited, but there were many medium and small cities in the surrounding area.
As for Polaris City, being a main city, accommodating over a hundred million people was easily within its means.
Immediately afterward, Daniel used the remaining 400 million points to purchase a large quantity of potions, EXP cards, skill books, and companion eggs.
These items were not expensive individually, but their sheer quantity made them immensely valuable.
With this batch of consumables, both the guild players and the NPCs under his command would experience a significant rise in strength!
Daniel knew very well that the flap of his butterfly wings had already stirred up an incomparably violent storm in the world of Stellar.

The progress of the game was accelerating forward at a terrifying pace, yet the NPC nobles slumbering within the Human Empire were still immersed in the old order, utterly unaware that the tide of the times had already changed course.
They would not even realize that disaster was drawing closer at an ever-increasing speed.
Every version to come would be an apocalyptic catastrophe.
Placing his hopes in those rigid, step-by-step imperial bureaucrats was no different from trying to rely on a straw for survival in the middle of a storm!
He had to forge a force that truly belonged to him—both for himself and for humanity.
That was why investing in NPCs and cultivating his own legion was not merely a choice, but an absolute necessity.
What was more, NPC loyalty was far more dependable than that of players, who could be swayed at any moment by profit or fear.
Players might betray him, shrink back, or flee for their lives at the most critical moment.
But the NPC warriors he personally nurtured—so long as the contract remained—would never abandon him.
Investing in players might end in total loss.
But every resource spent on NPCs would one day become the firmest shield and the sharpest spear in his hands!
After taking one final look at his abundant gains, Daniel closed the exchange interface.
"Exit the dungeon event!"
Whoosh—!
A flash of white light passed, and Daniel’s figure reappeared beside the portal in Skyhold.
After returning to the ducal residence in Polaris City, the first thing he did was take out those seven Flight Mastery Fragments!
The seven fragments slowly floated above his palm, radiating a pale golden light. Fine chains of light faintly linked them together.
"Synthesize."
[Ding! You are synthesizing "Flight Arcana Core (supreme-grade)." This operation requires the secondary profession of legendary-grade Engineer. Confirm?]
"Confirm!"
One minute later, golden light burst forth.
The seven fragments fused together within the radiance, transforming into a fist-sized golden core.
Ancient runes covered its surface, while streams of light swirled inside it, as though it contained the very essence of the wind itself!
[Ding! Synthesis successful! Obtained "Flight Arcana Core (supreme-grade)"!]
[Flight Arcana Core (supreme-grade)]
Type: Wing Equipment Enhancement Core
Effect: Can be fused with wing equipment of legendary-grade or above, greatly enhancing the performance of the wing equipment.
Description: A core containing ancient flight arcana. Once fused with wing equipment, it grants the wearer a transcendent power of flight beyond mortal limits.
Daniel took out [Black Dragon Wing].
This piece of supreme-grade equipment had accompanied him for a long time, yet its potential had still not been fully unearthed.
Now, it was finally time for it to evolve once more.
He activated the Flight Arcana Core.
Bzzzz—!
A dazzling burst of golden light erupted from the wings, illuminating the entire room.

Within the radiance, Black Dragon Wing slowly began to transform. Golden patterns emerged across its originally black scales, sharper bony spikes extended from its edges, and its wingspan expanded from ten meters to fifteen meters.
Every feather shimmered with a black-gold luster, and arcs of lightning flickered faintly across the surface.
[Ding! Fusion successful! "Black Dragon Wing" has evolved into "Eternal Black King (supreme-grade)"!]
Daniel raised a brow and immediately opened its status panel.
[Eternal Black King (supreme-grade)]
Type: Wing Equipment (Bound)
Additional Effects:

[Eternal Wingspan]: Upon activation, spreads its wings. Flight Speed +8000%, consumes no MP. [High-Speed Cruise]: In long-distance flight mode, speed becomes 500% of the character’s current Agility stat, consuming 200 MP per second. [Black King Barrier]: Once activated, the wings can be used to block damage from the front. Maximum damage capacity: 20,000,000 points (repairable). [Undying Structure]: The wing equipment has infinite durability and can never be destroyed. If struck by an attack exceeding its damage capacity, the wings will automatically retract.

Description: A legendary pair of wings fused with ancient flight arcana. The black-gold feathers flow with the power of a Black Dragon. The instant you spread these wings, you become the sovereign of the skies!
After reading its attributes, Daniel could no longer suppress the smile on his lips.
Although this equipment was still only supreme-grade, one had to know that even among supreme-grade items, there were enormous differences!
And those differences could truly be described as worlds apart.
For example, supreme-grade gear produced from boosting ordinary equipment generally had rather average stats.
But compared with high-tier gear that already possessed special effects and skills, the latter could greatly expand the upper limits of its inherent attributes!
The current Eternal Black King had received a tremendous enhancement—its flight speed had risen to 8000%, its damage capacity had reached 20 million, and it could even negate overflow damage!
And one had to remember: these were only its additional enhancements. Its original attribute bonuses and skills had not been overwritten at all!
It could be said that this pair of wings was no longer merely a piece of equipment, but a mobile fortress!
He immediately equipped it.
[Prompt: You have equipped "Eternal Black King."]
Looking again at his current equipment and attribute bonuses, Daniel felt a profound sense of security rise within him.
At this rate of growth, perhaps he really could overturn all the destined cataclysmic endings when that day finally came!
Daniel calmed himself and turned his gaze toward Carodion, who stood behind him.
Next, he planned to bring Carodion back to Ironforge.
There were still 50 million legion warriors and tens of millions of NPC civilians waiting there for him to receive!
With a thought, the black-gold wings unfurled behind him.
The fifteen-meter wings spread like a canopy over the sky, each feather reflecting a cold metallic sheen, with golden arcs of lightning dancing along the edges!
"Let’s go."
He said to Carodion.
Carodion nodded, silently expanding his form and following close behind.
The two figures tore across the heavens, racing toward Ironforge like bolts of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 -97-An Epic-Grade Plague Calamity
paragraphs: Ironforge.
The moment Daniel landed, he immediately summoned Hudson, Victor, and Alan.
He handed most of the resources he had obtained from this dungeon run over to the three of them—
eighty percent of the EXP cards, skill books, companion eggs, and all of the Special Unit Class Awakening Scrolls.
"Use these supplies to train an elite legion."
Daniel’s voice was calm, yet left no room for doubt. "I want to see a true iron army of humankind."
Hudson took the inventory list, and his hands trembled slightly.
Fifty million gold-grade warriors, tens of millions of civilians, hundreds of thousands of skill books, hundreds of thousands of companion eggs...
Even across the entire Human Empire, no lord could have produced such a staggering amount of resources so casually.
"Please rest assured, Your Grace."
Hudson gave a solemn bow. "I will not fail you."
At that moment, however, Alan stepped forward, his expression somewhat grave.
"Your Grace, there is something I must report."
"Speak."
"At present, the scout squads of the Doom Legion have spread throughout the territories of the non-human races. We have discovered signs that they are gathering large armies."
Daniel’s gaze sharpened. "Which races?"
"The coalition consists of six races: goblins, beastfolk, dwarves, dark elves, mammoths, and Bimon."
Alan spoke in a deep voice.
Daniel nodded.
"It seems the Empire is about to undergo a bloody cleansing."
"Exactly."

Alan let out a sigh. "Right now, the entire Empire is already in chaos... Oh, and after you left, the military headquarters in Luminara sent someone over with a scroll. They said they need your assistance in a certain matter."
Daniel raised a brow slightly. It seemed this matter was anything but simple.
Even the military had come knocking at his door?
"Give me the scroll."
Alan took a parchment scroll from his robes and respectfully handed it over with both hands.
Daniel accepted it and unrolled it.
[Ding! Do you wish to accept the hidden quest "Plaguefall (epic-grade)" ?]
The instant he heard the system prompt, Daniel’s expression shifted slightly.
This quest... he remembered it!
In his previous lives, this hidden version quest had only appeared two months after the server opened.
According to players who had posted about it on the forums, this quest would only be issued to the player who ranked highest in current faction standing, Contribution Points, and similar metrics!
And now, even this had appeared ahead of schedule.
Without the slightest hesitation, he clicked Confirm.
[Prompt: You have accepted the quest "Plaguefall (epic-grade)"! Please check the details in the quest log.]
Daniel opened the quest panel.
[Plaguefall (epic-grade)]
Quest Objectives:
Investigate the strange plague spreading throughout the Empire. Develop a potion capable of curing the plague. Trace the source of the plague and eliminate the mastermind behind it.
Quest Description:

Not long ago, an extremely terrifying plague appeared within the Empire. It is spreading across the entire Empire with unstoppable momentum. Preliminary research by the Alchemists’ Guild shows that this plague is exceptionally difficult to deal with. A massive number of civilians have already been infected, and the death toll is rising sharply. Please develop a countermeasure as soon as possible, stop the plague from spreading, and completely resolve this disaster!
Time Limit: Long-term
Quest Rewards: A large amount of Contribution Points, a large amount of gold coins, a large amount of merit points, Imperial Popular Support, Human Contribution...
As Daniel looked at the quest, his brows drew tightly together.
In his previous life, he had read quite a few guides and knew that the source of the plague was a cemetery corrupted by darkness.
And the final boss of this quest was an early-stage legendary-grade monster spawned by the power of a Dark God!
"Legendary-grade..."
Daniel took a deep breath.
Before entering the dungeon, he might not have been a match for a legendary-grade powerhouse.
But now, his strength had increased severalfold!
In his previous lives, players who wanted to clear this quest had to rely on legendary-grade NPC experts from the Empire.
As a result, no one had ever obtained the quest’s most complete system rewards.
But if this time he could solo-kill that early-stage legendary-grade boss...
Then the perfect-grade reward would be within easy reach!
And the value of a perfect-grade reward was beyond estimation.
Daniel opened his skill panel.
[Serpent’s Thundercell]

The duration of this skill depended entirely on the caster’s MP and stamina, and with the support of [Infinite Grail] and countless potions, Daniel’s values in both categories were practically inexhaustible.
That meant he could maintain Serpent’s Thundercell without interruption forever!
A domain that never ended, covered an entire city, and dealt damage equal to 100% of his Attack Power every second...
Just imagining that scene was enough to make one’s scalp go numb.
Then Daniel thought of another skill—[Wind’s Embrace]!
Ten minutes of absolute stasis, combined with the endless output of Serpent’s Thundercell...
"If those two skills are used together..."
A cold curve lifted the corner of his lips. "Solo-killing an early-stage legendary-grade boss will be more than enough!"
Daniel closed his skill panel, activated Eternal Black King, and flew toward Dragon’s Slumber.
The black-gold wings traced a dazzling arc beneath the sunlight, and in the blink of an eye, he vanished into the horizon.
Dragon’s Slumber.
A figure descended from the sky and landed steadily at the city gates.
[Prompt: You have discovered "Dragon’s Slumber." Contribution Points +1000!]
Daniel looked over the city.
The streets were nearly empty. The few pedestrians passing by all wore thick masks, their faces filled with fear and unease.
A suffocating atmosphere hung over the entire city like dark storm clouds.
Following the memories from his previous life, Daniel arrived at the entrance of an alchemy shop.
Inside the shop—
a woman in a dark blue alchemist’s robe was staring blankly at the alchemy array before her.
The materials within the array had not changed in the slightest.
Which meant...
the refinement had failed yet again!
As one of the Empire’s very few black-gold-grade alchemists, Alena felt a deep sense of defeat.
Alchemy followed the principle of equivalent exchange.
If nothing changed within the alchemy array, that meant the energy could not be converted, and the potion refinement had failed.
"So... it failed again, after all..."
Alena’s eyes reddened slightly.
She thought of the civilians struggling on the brink of death under the plague, and her chest felt so heavy she could barely breathe.
She had exhausted everything she had learned in her lifetime, yet still could not refine a potion capable of curing the plague.
"So it’s true... just as my mentors said. Only a legendary-grade alchemist can refine a cure for this plague?"
She lowered her head, her hands clenched tightly into fists.
"I... I’m not willing to accept this. I want to try one more time."
Just then—
Knock, knock, knock!
A sound came from the door.
Alena froze for a moment, then hurriedly put on a mask and opened the shop door.
Standing outside was a young mage.
He wore a silver-white robe, with a starlit longbow slung across his back. His features were cool and refined, his gaze deep and tranquil.
"Good day."
Daniel gave a slight nod. "I am Faustus, here under Imperial orders to investigate the plague."
Alena looked at him curiously, then stepped aside to let him in.

sentences.text: Ironforge.
The moment Daniel landed, he immediately summoned Hudson, Victor, and Alan.
He handed most of the resources he had obtained from this dungeon run over to the three of them—
eighty percent of the EXP cards, skill books, companion eggs, and all of the Special Unit Class Awakening Scrolls.
"Use these supplies to train an elite legion."
Daniel’s voice was calm, yet left no room for doubt.
"I want to see a true iron army of humankind."
Hudson took the inventory list, and his hands trembled slightly.
Fifty million gold-grade warriors, tens of millions of civilians, hundreds of thousands of skill books, hundreds of thousands of companion eggs...
Even across the entire Human Empire, no lord could have produced such a staggering amount of resources so casually.
"Please rest assured, Your Grace."
Hudson gave a solemn bow.
"I will not fail you."
At that moment, however, Alan stepped forward, his expression somewhat grave.
"Your Grace, there is something I must report."
"Speak."
"At present, the scout squads of the Doom Legion have spread throughout the territories of the non-human races.
We have discovered signs that they are gathering large armies."
Daniel’s gaze sharpened.
"Which races?"
"The coalition consists of six races: goblins, beastfolk, dwarves, dark elves, mammoths, and Bimon."
Alan spoke in a deep voice.
Daniel nodded.
"It seems the Empire is about to undergo a bloody cleansing."
"Exactly."
Alan let out a sigh.
"Right now, the entire Empire is already in chaos...
Oh, and after you left, the military headquarters in Luminara sent someone over with a scroll.
They said they need your assistance in a certain matter."
Daniel raised a brow slightly.
It seemed this matter was anything but simple.
Even the military had come knocking at his door?
"Give me the scroll."
Alan took a parchment scroll from his robes and respectfully handed it over with both hands.
Daniel accepted it and unrolled it.
[Ding!
Do you wish to accept the hidden quest "Plaguefall (epic-grade)" ?]
The instant he heard the system prompt, Daniel’s expression shifted slightly.
This quest... he remembered it!

Please develop a countermeasure as soon as possible, stop the plague from spreading, and completely resolve this disaster!

chapters.title: Chapter 98 -98-Advancement — Legendary-Grade Alchemist
paragraphs: After the two of them sat down, Alena slowly began to speak.
"The source of this plague lies in the Dragon Graveyard outside Dragon’s Slumber."
She paused, a flicker of fear passing across her face.

"At first, only one of the gravekeepers in the cemetery was infected. Later, even the priest who treated him caught it as well. In less than half a month, the plague had spread throughout the entirety of Dragon’s Slumber."

"After that, large numbers of imperial citizens in the surrounding cities were infected too. By last month, the plague had already reached Galehold... and by now, I fear it may have spread across the whole Empire."
She let out a sigh, her voice slightly choked with emotion.
"Setting aside the other regions, in Dragon’s Slumber alone, tens of thousands of imperial citizens have died from it within just one month."
Daniel fell silent for a moment before asking, "What are the characteristics of this plague?"
Alena forcibly suppressed the grief in her heart.

"This plague can spread through any medium, and it can also attach itself to all kinds of living creatures. Its infectivity is terrifyingly strong. Once someone is infected, a fiendish seed will be born inside the patient’s body. That seed will continue to devour the host’s life until the host dies. As for where those fiendish seeds go in the end... we still do not know."
Daniel listened carefully to the end.
[Ding! You have completed Phase One of the quest: "Investigate the Source of the Plague"!]
He rose to his feet and bade Alena farewell.
Before leaving, he turned back to look at her and said calmly,
"Please believe this: the dawn of mankind will surely come."
Alena nodded heavily, but the gloom in her heart did not lessen in the slightest.
After leaving the shop, Daniel revealed a composed expression.
Back in his previous lives, the formula for a potion that could cure this plague had already been posted on the game forums.
In order to complete this quest, Daniel had deliberately memorized that formula during his second life.
It was worth mentioning that the formula had originally been developed by the players together with Alena.
But now, he no longer needed to go through all those tedious side quests.
With the formula already in hand, he could simply brew it directly.
He unfurled the Eternal Black King and flew toward Luminara.
Luminara, Alchemists’ Guild.
Inside the guild hall, the attendant saw Daniel and immediately hurried forward respectfully.
"Your Grace the Duke, how may I be of service?"
"I want to learn the secondary profession of alchemist."
"Of course."
The attendant smiled. "This is your second secondary profession. Normally, the introductory fee would be ten gold coins, but for an honored guest such as yourself, you need only pay one silver coin."
[Prompt: Spend 1 silver coin to purchase "Basic Alchemist Principles"? Note: At your current level, you may only learn two secondary professions at the same time.]
"Yes."
With a wave of the attendant’s hand, a golden light appeared before Daniel.
Immediately afterward, Daniel decisively sold the introductory manual to the guild shop.
[Ding! You have successfully sold a secondary-class introductory skill book to the Doom Guild, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Ding! You have obtained 1 gold coin, and you have received "Legendary-Grade Alchemist Arcana"!]
The corner of Daniel’s mouth lifted slightly.
"I need to use your study chamber."
"Certainly, Your Grace. You may use the highest-grade study chamber completely free of charge."
The attendant bowed respectfully.
Daniel nodded and strode into the interior of the guild.
Inside the study chamber.
Half an hour later, Daniel had successfully completed all of the arcane study.
[Ding! Your "Alchemist" class rank has been raised to "Legendary-Grade"!]
A brilliant golden radiance erupted from Daniel’s body, illuminating the entire study chamber in dazzling splendor.
[Legendary-Grade Alchemist]
Effects:

Success rate for all alchemy +100% (guaranteed success) The quality of all alchemical products is at least Blackgold-grade Can craft legendary-grade potions and special items Alchemy time reduced by 95%
Description: The supreme realm of alchemy, where one thought can turn stone into gold. In the entire history of the Empire, no more than three people have ever reached this level.
Looking at that line of description, Daniel could no longer suppress the smile on his face.
Legendary-Grade Alchemist!
This meant that from now on, any potion he brewed would succeed without fail, and at a minimum, it would be of Blackgold-grade quality.
Now that his alchemist class had successfully advanced, Daniel did not hesitate any longer.
He immediately followed the potion formula from memory, purchased the required materials through the study chamber panel, and placed them all into the transmutation array.
[Prompt: Brew "Unnamed Potion"?]
"Yes."
The transmutation array lit up, and all of the materials vanished in an instant.
A moment later, a potion glowing with pale golden light appeared within the array.
[Prompt: You have successfully brewed "Unnamed Potion." Alchemist class EXP +100!]
[Prompt: Please name the potion you have just brewed.]
"Dawn."
Daniel answered without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! You have named the potion "Dawn"!]
[Ding! Obtained "Dawn Elixir (Blackgold-grade)" ×1!]
Daniel took the potion out of the transmutation array.
[Dawn Elixir (Blackgold-grade)]
Effect: After consumption, it can perfectly cure a certain strange plague and all of its variants.
Description: This potion was developed by the imperial duke and Legendary-Grade Alchemist, "Faustus," in order to resolve the Empire’s plague disaster.
Holding the Dawn Elixir in his hand, a cold glint flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
Of the quest’s three major objectives, he had already completed two—investigate the source of the plague, and develop the cure.
Only the final one remained: eradicate the mastermind behind it all!
That legendary-grade beginner-level monster that had been forcibly nurtured by the Dark Council.
Daniel had no intention of relying on the strength of the Empire’s legendary-grade powerhouses, as the players had in his previous lives.
He would act personally.
"Legendary-grade..."
He put away the potion, a chilly arc curving at the corner of his lips.
"Let me see just how capable you really are."
Daniel stored the pale golden potion in his robes and immediately set off for the Ministry of War.
Inside the Ministry of War’s main hall, candlelight illuminated the broad stone chamber with a warm brightness.
Minister Kasel stood with his hands behind his back, pacing before the long table. The sound of his boots striking the stone floor was hurried and uneven.
This military minister, who was usually as steady as a mountain, now resembled an old wolf trapped in a cage, restless with anxiety.
Ahem!
Daniel stopped at the entrance and let out a light cough.
Kasel spun around sharply. In his weary eyes, light burst forth at once.
He closed the distance in three quick strides, his voice brimming with barely restrained urgency.
"Your Grace the Duke... has there been progress?"
Daniel took out the potion from his robes and handed it to him.
The golden liquid flowed slowly inside the glass vial like sunlight made solid.
"A miracle cure for this plague,"
he said briefly.
Kasel received the potion with both hands, moving as gently as though he were cradling a star that might shatter at any moment.
He lowered his head and stared at the light inside the vial. His lips trembled slightly, and only after a long while did he find his voice again.
"I knew it... so long as Your Grace takes action, there is nothing that cannot be done."
Daniel then pulled a parchment filled with the formula from his inventory and laid it flat upon the table.
The writing on it was neat and clear. Every step, every ingredient, had been marked down in exact detail.
"The Ministry of War can test the potion on infected patients. This is the complete formula."
Kasel looked at him with gratitude and let out a long sigh.
In that sigh was not only the relief of a burden lifted, but also profound respect.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 -99-Legendary-Grade Fallen Mage
paragraphs: "With Your Grace here, it is truly a blessing for the human race."
Kasel paused, and his expression suddenly turned grave.

"It’s just that... the Empire’s investigation has revealed that the mastermind behind this plague is a fallen mage named Harland. His hideout lies deep within the graveyard outside Dragon’s Slumber. I hope that Your Grace can join forces with the Ministry of War’s experts and slay this scourge upon mankind together."
[Prompt: You have obtained the clue for Phase Three of the quest. Proceed to the "Dragon Graveyard" and kill LV120 Fallen Mage Harland (Legendary-Grade)!]
"I’d be happy to handle it."
Daniel nodded, his tone so calm it sounded as though he were speaking of something utterly ordinary.
"But I alone will be enough."
He turned and made to leave at once.
If the Ministry of War’s powerhouses came along, they would only drag down the mission rating.
He had no interest in taking that kind of loss.
"Your Grace, please wait!"
Kasel’s voice came from behind him, unable to hide the anxiety within it.
"To create an evil-spirit plague capable of covering the entire Empire, the enemy’s strength is surely far beyond that of ordinary powerhouses... does Your Grace truly not need any assistance?"
Daniel glanced back at him, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth.
"Leave it to me."
Before the words had even fully fallen, his figure had already vanished from the spot.
Kasel stared at the empty stone floor in silence for a moment.
Then he shook his head, turned around, and ordered his subordinates to begin testing the medicine, while also making arrangements for mass production.
Dragon Graveyard.
Gray-white mist shrouded the entire wasteland, like the final breath exhaled by the earth itself.
The moment Daniel appeared in this land of deathly stillness, a cold system notification rang in his ears.

[Prompt: You have entered the special zone "Curtain of Darkness"! Current all attributes -50%! You have gained the negative effect "Shadow Erosion": three active skills are randomly sealed! You have gained the negative effect "Nightmare Mirage": Max HP -50%, Max MP -50%!]
Daniel’s expression remained unchanged.
These curse-like debuffs would have been enough to leave any ordinary player unable to take a single step forward, but to him, they were nothing more than a passing breeze.
He raised a hand, and a pale golden halo spread out from his palm like the first ray of dawn breaking across the horizon, sweeping away the gray mist around him.
[Fated Purification].
The suffocating curses vanished into the golden light as if they had never existed at all.
At that very moment—
Boom!
A muffled peal of thunder suddenly exploded through the void, shaking the entire wasteland.
Daniel looked up.
The space ahead began to distort, and a pitch-black vortex appeared out of nowhere, as though someone had torn open a rift in the curtain of the world itself.
The vortex spun faster and faster, greedily devouring the surrounding air, light, and even sound itself.
Soon, the wind died, the mist dispersed, and even the sound of a heartbeat seemed to be swallowed by that endless darkness.
A figure wearing a black mask and holding a jet-black staff stepped slowly out of the vortex.
His entire body was wrapped in dark robes. With every step he took upon the void, ripples of darkness spread outward, as though he were walking across solidified night itself.
Walking through the void—the mark of a legendary-grade powerhouse!
Daniel narrowed his eyes and quietly cast a detection spell.
[Fallen Mage · Harland (LV120 · Legendary-Grade)]
Skills: All Dark-element Magic, Evil Spirit Barrier, God-Grade Spell Damage, Immortality (Passive Trait)
Immortal Singularity: 5
[Immortal Trait]: A divine power condensed from Immortal Singularity, the insurmountable gulf between legendary-grade beings and mortals.

Description: Fallen Mage Harland, a once-in-several-centuries genius of the dark magic lineage. His mentor is the legendary-grade peak dark-element powerhouse with the highest bounty on the Empire’s most-wanted list. Though still young, Harland has already stepped into the ranks of the continent’s great powers, and is absolutely not an opponent current players can challenge.
Daniel quickly scanned Harland’s information, a faint frown appearing on his brow.
Immortal Singularity determined the upper limit of a legendary-grade powerhouse’s strength!
It could allow the four core attributes to break beyond mortal limits, and it could also grant its holder regeneration, longevity, and even immortality itself.
Put simply, every point of Immortal Singularity was an extra life!
At the same time, Harland on the opposite side was also sizing up this uninvited guest.
Behind the mask, his eyes held the same contempt a cat might show a mouse.
"Are all the Empire’s people dead already?"
Harland’s voice was hoarse and low, like mutterings echoing out of a tomb.
"That they would actually send an ant here to die?"
Daniel curled his lip.
The easiest flaw for young geniuses to fall into was arrogance.
His figure flashed—God Speed!
In the next instant, he was already standing less than ten meters in front of Harland.
Stellar Wrath rose, and the vibration of the bowstring sounded like a silent judgment.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Invisible power of wind surged in from all directions, binding Harland firmly in place.
The winds seemed to come alive, transforming into countless transparent chains that wrapped around his limbs, throat, and waist, leaving him unable to move even a single finger.
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Boom—!
The sky suddenly exploded!
Dense storm clouds formed in an instant, while purple lightning churned and roared within them like an enraged primordial beast.

In the next second, countless bolts of lightning poured down from the clouds, exploding above Harland’s head and transforming into tens of thousands of thunder-serpents that wildly lashed toward his body.
Crackle—!
Purple electric light illuminated the entire wasteland as bright as day!
The thunder-serpents exploded across Harland’s body, each strike carrying enough force to tear through iron and stone.
Tens of thousands of thunder-serpents exploded against Harland every second, filling the air with a dense storm of damage numbers.
At this rate, his enormous HP bar would be completely emptied in less than three seconds!
And yet Harland still stood there.
Daniel was not surprised. He cast Detection once more.
[Immortal Singularity: 4 points]
Just as expected!
In that single instant just now, Harland had consumed one point of Immortal Singularity and forcibly endured what should have been fatal damage.
That drop of Immortal Singularity was like an invisible shield, shutting death out beyond the gate.
This was the most terrifying aspect of legendary-grade powerhouses.
Every point of Immortal Singularity was an extra life.
Although there was no real difficulty here, Daniel still did not let his guard down. The arrows in his hand never stopped.
Serpent’s Thundercell had no time limit. As long as he had enough MP and stamina, he could maintain it forever.
And those were precisely the two things he lacked the least!
Harland was pinned firmly in place by [Wind’s Embrace]. Under the dual effects of silence and paralysis, he could neither cast spells nor move.
He was like a statue nailed upon an altar, able only to watch helplessly as the endless thunder tore through his body again and again.
He frantically drove the little Immortal Singularity he had left within his body, using it over and over to resist the fatal damage.
With every point consumed, his face turned a shade paler.
It was a despair deeper than death itself.
To watch, helplessly, as one’s lives were stripped away one after another, yet have no power to resist.
"Damn it..."
Harland ground his teeth, his voice filled with humiliation and unwillingness.
"Am I, a legendary-grade existence—the Empire’s most brilliant dark mage—really going to fall today at the hands of this despicable wretch?"
No one answered him.
There was only the endless thunder, descending upon him without pause.

"It’s just that... the Empire’s investigation has revealed that the mastermind behind this plague is a fallen mage named Harland.
His hideout lies deep within the graveyard outside Dragon’s Slumber.
I hope that Your Grace can join forces with the Ministry of War’s experts and slay this scourge upon mankind together."

Proceed to the "Dragon Graveyard" and kill LV120 Fallen Mage Harland (Legendary-Grade)!]

He had no interest in taking that kind of loss.

"To create an evil-spirit plague capable of covering the entire Empire, the enemy’s strength is surely far beyond that of ordinary powerhouses... does Your Grace truly not need any assistance?"
Daniel glanced back at him, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth.
"Leave it to me."
Before the words had even fully fallen, his figure had already vanished from the spot.

Current all attributes -50%!
You have gained the negative effect "Shadow Erosion": three active skills are randomly sealed!
You have gained the negative effect "Nightmare Mirage": Max HP -50%, Max MP -50%!]
